            shed light on

            帮助解释、增进对……的理解

            这是照亮的比喻，常用于研究贡献；比prove更克制，不表示一次研究已经解决全部问题。

            句子精读

            He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

            他认为，除了外在行为，还需要脑成像来显示章鱼是否在梦中重演清醒生活中的一连串活动。

            He指Scheel；argues that标明这是他的研究判断。主句内容是brain imaging is needed，as well as...补充已有的行为证据。to show说明成像的目的，后面的that从句是待支持的解释；from their waking lives修饰activities，与in dreams形成清醒经历和梦中重演的关系。原文并不是说成像证据已经取得。

            And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

            如果情况确实如此，那么更好地理解这些功能，或许能帮助我们理解自身梦境的真正用途。

            this is the case回指上一句梦可能自复杂动物出现以来承担多种功能。it是形式主语，that从句给出真正内容；better understanding是该从句主语，these purposes指梦的多种功能。if、possible、might共同保留条件和不确定性，不能把整句改述为研究已经确定人类做梦的目的。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            shed light on

            帮助增进理解

            常见搭配是research/findings may shed light on a process or question。适合讨论基础研究的潜在贡献，同时保留may、could等程度词，不把研究方向写成已经证实的成果。

            用于写作：科研由政府还是企业控制的题目涉及研究激励；该表达可用于说明公共资金支持无即时商业回报的基础研究这一理由。它是写作中的政策论点，不是原文对资助模式作出的结论。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Mapungubwe｜农业、居所与社会等级未作答段落信息匹配 · 3 段 · 414 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 43 页

            Which paragraph contains the following information? Write A–G. 保留完整原候选字母；本片段为A–C，C跨PDF43–44页连续接回。

            AMapungubwe, which was one of the first states in southern Africa, was formed by Bantu-speaking peoples who were farmers. The area controlled by the rulers of Mapungubwe had at its heart a large sandstone plateau, which was easily defended due to its inaccessibility. As with other kingdoms in the region of southern Africa, cattle herding and other types of farming brought plenty of food and a surplus that could be traded for needed goods. Archaeology has revealed extensive layers of bones and manure, which indicate that from the 9th century CE there were large cattle herds, the traditional source of political power in southern African communities. The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.

            BThe total population of Mapungubwe at its peak in the mid-13th century was around 5,000 people. The chief or king of Mapungubwe was likely the wealthiest individual in the society, and would have owned more cattle and precious materials than anyone else. The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length. Occupation on the hill dates from the 11th century and the entire complex was surrounded by a wooden palisade*, as indicated by postholes made in the rock. The rest of the community lived in mud and thatch housing spread out below the hill, although there is one stone structure here. This settlement, known as Babandyanalo, covers around 5 hectares (12.3 acres) and predates the hilltop structures.

            CThe kings of Mapungubwe were buried at the top of the hill site in a demarcated area away from the dwellings, while other members of the community were buried at the surrounding valley level. A wooden staircase connected the two levels, the sockets for the steps being clearly visible in the sandstone cliff face. There were some grander residences dotted around the outskirts of Babandyanalo, and these probably belonged to male relatives of the king. There are many other smaller but still impressive sites across the Mapungubwe plateau, which are located anywhere from 15 to 100 kilometres from the major hill site. Containing stone residences and walls, they likely belonged to local chiefs who acted as servants to the king.

            * palisade: typically a row of closely placed, high vertical wooden or iron posts used as a means of defence

            共用选项 · 原题 16、18、19

            • A
            • B
            • C
            • D
            • E
            • F
            • G

            16. a mention of the location where members of the king's family are thought to have lived

            18. an estimate of the size to which the Mapungubwe community grew

            19. a mention of agricultural produce being exchanged for other items

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 16 题 · C

            male relatives对应king’s family；地点是outskirts，不能把国王hilltop宫殿当成亲属居所。

            grander residences dotted around the outskirts of Babandyanalo, and these probably belonged to male relatives of the king

            第 18 题 · B

            size指人口规模，peak与around表示高峰估计值；不是面积5 hectares。

            The total population of Mapungubwe at its peak in the mid-13th century was around 5,000 people

            第 19 题 · A

            农牧业产生剩余→交换所需物品，traded对应exchanged。

            a surplus that could be traded for needed goods

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            文章借农业遗存、住宅位置与墓地分布重建Mapungubwe的社会结构。食物盈余支持贸易，牛群与权力相关，高低不同的居所和埋葬地点则展示社会等级；部分身份判断来自考古推测，保留likely和probably的限度。

            A

            A Mapungubwe, which was one of the first states in southern Africa, was formed by Bantu-speaking peoples who were farmers. The area controlled by the rulers of Mapungubwe had at its heart a large sandstone plateau, which was easily defended due to its inaccessibility. As with other kingdoms in the region of southern Africa, cattle herding and other types of farming brought plenty of food and a surplus that could be traded for needed goods. Archaeology has revealed extensive layers of bones and manure, which indicate that from the 9th century CE there were large cattle herds, the traditional source of political power in southern African communities. The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.

            Mapungubwe由说班图语、从事农业的人群建立，控制区域以难以接近、易于防守的砂岩高地为中心。畜牧和种植带来食物盈余，可用于交换物资。骨骼、粪便和纺轮等遗存支持关于牛群、棉花种植及织布的认识，牛在当地传统中也与政治权力相连。作者把地理条件、生产能力和国家形成放在同一背景中。

            B

            B The total population of Mapungubwe at its peak in the mid-13th century was around 5,000 people. The chief or king of Mapungubwe was likely the wealthiest individual in the society, and would have owned more cattle and precious materials than anyone else. The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length. Occupation on the hill dates from the 11th century and the entire complex was surrounded by a wooden palisade*, as indicated by postholes made in the rock. The rest of the community lived in mud and thatch housing spread out below the hill, although there is one stone structure here. This settlement, known as Babandyanalo, covers around 5 hectares (12.3 acres) and predates the hilltop structures.

            13世纪中叶鼎盛时，人口约为5000。国王可能拥有最多的牛和珍贵物品，他与顾问居住在高处石墙围成的建筑群，普通居民住在山下泥土与茅草房中。岩石柱洞提供木栅栏存在的线索。山下Babandyanalo聚落早于山顶建筑，这说明空间上的高低与建筑形成的先后是不同维度，不能把山上自动理解为最早居住区。

            C

            C The kings of Mapungubwe were buried at the top of the hill site in a demarcated area away from the dwellings, while other members of the community were buried at the surrounding valley level. A wooden staircase connected the two levels, the sockets for the steps being clearly visible in the sandstone cliff face. There were some grander residences dotted around the outskirts of Babandyanalo, and these probably belonged to male relatives of the king. There are many other smaller but still impressive sites across the Mapungubwe plateau, which are located anywhere from 15 to 100 kilometres from the major hill site. Containing stone residences and walls, they likely belonged to local chiefs who acted as servants to the king.

            社会等级也延续到墓地：国王葬在山顶划定区域，其他居民葬在周围谷地，两层由木梯连接。山下外围较大的住宅可能属于男性王族，远处较小但精致的石筑遗址可能属于侍奉国王的地方首领。probably和likely保留了所有者身份的推断性；这些建筑共同提示一个中心与周边相联系的权力网络。

            词语与搭配

            due to its inaccessibility

            由于它难以接近

            due to引出原因，its指砂岩高地；这里困难的交通条件反而带来防御优势。

            a surplus that could be traded

            可以用于交易的盈余

            surplus指超过自身即时需要的部分，could表明交换的可能性；不是所有产出都拿去交易。

            a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle

            家养牛数量的显著增加

            marked强调变化明显，the number of后接复数名词；本段依据考古记录作出描述，没有给出精确增长百分比。

            predates the hilltop structures

            早于山顶建筑

            predate是动词，直接接较晚出现的事物，说明时间先后，而非评价建筑的重要性。

            dotted around the outskirts

            零星分布在外围

            dotted around形容分散布局，outskirts通常指聚落边缘；这里描述较大住宅的空间位置。

            句子精读

            The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.

            10世纪的考古记录显示，当地家养牛的数量明显增加，同时出现棉花种植和织布活动，丰富的纺轮发现提供了相关线索。

            主语是The archaeological record，shows后并列牛群增加与棉花种植、织布两类信息。as well as用于增补，末尾as indicated by...说明证据关系；纺轮直接支持的是纺织活动，不应机械理解成纺轮证明了牛群数量。for the 10th century限定记录所属时期。

            The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length.

            国王和他的顾问住在由石墙与房屋组成的围区里，建筑位于聚落领地的最高处，也就是一座大约高30米、长100米的天然砂岩山丘上。

            主干是The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure。composed of...与built on...逐层补充围区的构成和位置；a natural sandstone hill对最高处作同位说明。which修饰hill，some在数字前表示约数而非一些山丘。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Mapungubwe｜贸易、器物与衰落未作答段落信息匹配 / 多项选择 / 摘要填空 · 4 段 · 430 词 · 10 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 44 页

            Q14/15/17：段落信息匹配A–G。Q20–21：Choose TWO letters A–E，顺序不限。Q22–26：Complete the summary. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage.

            DThe Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River. The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea. Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala. It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.

            EArchaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society. Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps. There are also ceramic discs, and whistles. In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found. The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known. Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.

            FBeautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe. A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it. These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold. One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads. These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150. They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.

            GThe kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts. Trade routes may also have shifted northwards. Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.

            共用选项 · 原题 14、15、17

            • A
            • B
            • C
            • D
            • E
            • F
            • G

            14. a mention of the uncertainty regarding the purpose of certain objects

            15. the likelihood that a climatic factor increased the problems Mapungubwe faced

            17. a reference to people who brought goods by ship

            20–21. The archaeological record reveals information about gold and the kingdom of Mapungubwe. Which TWO pieces of information are mentioned by the writer?

            • A Not everyone in Mapungubwe used gold as a form of payment.
            • B Items of gold were placed close to where Mapungubwe kings were buried.
            • C The most valuable item discovered in Mapungubwe was a sceptre made of gold.
            • D The way gold was decorated in Mapungubwe was also practised in another kingdom.
            • E Working with gold was a respected occupation in the Mapungubwe community.

            22. The Mapungubwe community's 22 __________ is indicated by the amount of professionally made pottery discovered at the site.

            23. Other finds include round ceramic objects, 23 __________ and figures of various animals

            24. as well as models of people with stretched 24 __________.

            25. It is possible that these had a role in ceremonies to honour 25 __________.

            26. In addition, pieces of 26 __________ made from a local metal have been found at the site.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 14 题 · E

            不确定性是precise function is not known，对象为figures；不是所有出土器物用途均不明。

            The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known.

            第 15 题 · G

            droughts是气候因素，进一步加剧过度人口带来的资源压力。

            a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts

            第 17 题 · D

            merchants是带货商人，by sea对应by ship。

            merchants travelling from India by sea

            第 20–21 题 · B；D

            B对应王室墓地；D由“found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe”支持。C把“可能是权杖”升级为“最有价值”，原文没有；E无职业声望信息。

            These objects were all found at the royal burial site

            第 22 题 · prosperity

            专业制陶规模是社会繁荣的指标；题干amount与large enough呼应。

            another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society

            第 23 题 · whistles

            ceramic discs已由round ceramic objects改写，下一并列项是whistles。

            There are also ceramic discs, and whistles.

            第 24 题 · bodies

            stretched对应elongated，而limbs被描述为short，应答bodies。

            humans with elongated bodies and short limbs

            第 25 题 · ancestors

            to honour对应as offerings to，保留祖先的复数。

            used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors

            第 26 题 · jewellery / jewelry

            local metal具体为copper，题干问金属制成的物品而非金属名；原答案接受英美拼写。

            small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            器物与贸易遗存让作者推测Mapungubwe的跨区域联系、工艺生产和政治权力；金器还显示珍贵材料不只有货币用途。结尾从繁荣转到衰落，并把人口、资源、旱灾和贸易变化作为可能相互作用的因素，而非单一确定原因。

            D

            D The Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River. The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea. Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala. It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.

            动物遗骸和象牙碎片使作者推测皮毛、象牙可能沿林波波河与沿海地区交易；玻璃珠则提示通过沿海商人与印度相连的贸易网络。当地铜以及经过该区域的黄金贸易也带来利益。最后进一步推测，为控制甚至垄断有利可图的区域联系，政治权力可能得到强化。器物发现、贸易路径与政治解释之间是逐层推论，并非所有细节都同样确定。

            E

            E Archaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society. Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps. There are also ceramic discs, and whistles. In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found. The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known. Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.

            大量陶器提示专业陶工可能存在，也被作者用来说明社会繁荣。器物包括容器、杯、碗、陶盘、哨子和动物或人物小像，其中一些有装饰。这些小像可能用于祭祖，但具体用途尚不清楚；当地铜制首饰则补充了手工业种类。形态可以较直接描述，用途仍需保留不确定性。

            F

            F Beautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe. A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it. These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold. One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads. These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150. They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.

            金器工艺包括把金制成小片、刻上几何图样，再用金钉覆盖木制物品；木质部分没有保存下来。可能的权杖、锤打金片制成的犀牛和大量金珠都来自约1150年的王室墓地。作者将这些解释为当地黄金除了交换货币用途，也具有自身珍贵意义的早期已知线索。first known限定的是目前所知证据，并非断言此前绝不可能存在。

            G

            G The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts. Trade routes may also have shifted northwards. Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.

            到13世纪末，王国已走向衰落。作者推测人口过多使资源承压，一系列干旱可能进一步把情况推向危机，贸易路线也可能北移。相比这些可能原因，北方大津巴布韦等地区后来兴盛是文中更明确陈述的趋势。段落保留多种因素共同作用的空间，没有给出唯一被证实的衰落原因。

            词语与搭配

            in turn

            继而、转而

            这里连接贸易链的下一环：沿海国家又与从印度来的商人交易，不是说每件物品都由Mapungubwe直接运到印度。

            on a scale large enough to suggest

            规模大到足以使人推测

            large enough to...说明达到某种程度，suggest保留由数量到专业分工的推断性。

            their precise function is not known

            它们的确切用途尚不清楚

            function指器物用途，their回指小像；已知外形不等于已知使用方式。

            an intrinsic value of its own

            自身具有的内在价值

            这里与货币交换价值相对照，描述黄金作为珍贵物品本身的意义。

            placed too much stress on local resources

            给当地资源施加了过大压力

            place stress on后接承压对象，local resources可以包括维持人口和生产所需的资源；本段用probably保留因果判断的限度。

            句子精读

            The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea.

            玻璃珠的出现——这些珠子几乎可以确定来自印度——表明当地曾与沿海其他国家进行某种贸易，而这些沿海国家又与乘船从印度来的商人交易。

            主干围绕The presence of glass beads说明其提示的贸易联系。almost certainly from India插入说明珠子的可能来源，of some sort保留对贸易具体形式的未知。who指沿海国家所代表的交易方，in turn引出下一环；travelling...修饰merchants。原文使用indicate，本句引用保留原样，阅读时核心名词presence按常规主谓一致应搭配indicates。

            The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts.

            到13世纪末，Mapungubwe王国已在衰落，可能因为人口过多给当地资源带来过大压力，而一系列干旱又可能使这种局面达到危机程度。

            主干是The kingdom...was already in decline，by限定到某个时间为止的状态。probably because引入可能原因，a situation概括资源受压的局面，that从句进一步说明旱灾可能如何加剧它。may have been brought是对过去事件的可能性判断，不是确认旱灾是唯一原因。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            placed too much stress on local resources

            给当地资源带来过大压力

            可根据句子时态改为place或places，保留place stress on的搭配。谈旅游时应具体说明水、土地或公共设施等资源，不能把古代王国衰落直接当作现代旅游的实证。

            用于写作：题目讨论旅游对当地环境与居民的代价；资源压力能够具体解释游客增长可能产生的成本。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Artificial Intelligence｜公众想象与解决一切的误区未作答选择题 · 3 段 · 202 词 · 2 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

            Choose the correct letter A, B, C or D. 原题Q27–28。

            原文第1段In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere. There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity. Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

            原文第2段While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'. This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems. But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

            原文第3段In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world. The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.

            27. What is the writer doing in the first paragraph?

            • A predicting the future impact of AI
            • B describing a public perception of AI
            • C outlining some possible benefits of AI
            • D highlighting the breadth of the influence of AI

            28. When discussing AI solutionism in the second paragraph, the writer

            • A points out a risk involved.
            • B specifies its probable origins.
            • C mentions its chief supporters.
            • D weighs up some pros and cons.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 27 题 · B

            you might think标记媒体造成的公众印象，不是作者预测AI一定实现所有益处。

            Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

            第 28 题 · A

            jeopardises与disregarding safety/setting unrealistic expectations明确提出这种思维的风险，未追溯起源或列主要支持者。

            this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            三段讨论人们如何想象AI：媒体渲染的未来图景，认为数据充足就能解决一切的心态，以及这种心态向政策圈的传播。作者承认技术机会，同时批评把机会扩大成万能承诺的思维。

            原文第1段

            In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere. There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity. Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

            第1段写西方许多国家对AI未来的强烈情绪和追求轰动的新闻。could所列的是新闻谈论的潜在能力，you might think则描述只看标题可能形成的印象；不能把“渗透社会每一方面”读成作者已经确认的现状。

            原文第2段

            While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'. This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems. But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

            第2段先承认AI带来大量有前景的机会，再引出“AI万能解决论”。given enough data属于这一心态的信念前提，不是作者承诺数据足够便能解决全部问题。后半说明作者担忧的是忽视安全与制造不现实预期，批评对象是这种思维，而不是一概否定AI。

            原文第3段

            In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world. The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.

            第3段从心态本身转向传播路径：技术圈的宣传进入政府官员和政策制定者的思考。钟摆比喻描述态度由“毁灭人类”转向“拯救人类”的另一个极端；dystopian和utopian分别标出极度悲观与理想化信念，不能当成作者对未来的两项预测。

            词语与搭配

            no shortage of

            大量；并不缺少

            后接名词，强调数量充足。此处修饰sensationalist news，数量多并不等于内容可靠。

            a wealth of promising opportunities

            大量有前景的机会

            a wealth of后接不可数或复数名词；promising表示值得期待，不表示成果已经兑现。

            given enough data

            在数据足够的条件下

            given在此引出前提。整个条件位于被解释的信念之内，不能脱离上下文当成作者认可的规律。

            setting unrealistic expectations about

            对……设定不切实际的预期

            set expectations about后面说明预期涉及什么；unrealistic批评的是与实际能力不相称的期望。

            The pendulum has swung

            钟摆已经摆向另一边；态度转向另一极端

            这里是态度变化的比喻，from...to...指出两个极端，不描述机器性能的变化。

            句子精读

            While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'.

            虽然不可否认AI已经打开了大量有前景的机会，但它也促成了一种心态的出现；这种心态最贴切的名称可以说是“AI万能解决论”。

            While表示让步；it is undeniable that...里的it是形式主语，that从句是所承认的内容。主句it has also led...中的it回指AI；that can be best described...修饰mindset，说明如何称呼这种心态。

            But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

            但事实上，这种心态没有支持AI的发展，反而因为忽视重要的AI安全原则，并对AI实际能为人类做什么设定不现实的期望，而危及机器智能的价值。

            this mindset回指AI solutionism；instead of supporting与actually jeopardises构成对照。by后面disregarding和setting并列，说明造成风险的两种方式。what从句说明预期涉及的实际能力范围。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            setting unrealistic expectations about

            对……设定不切实际的预期

            可在avoid等动词后保留setting形式，具体说明期待的成果或时间；不把所有期待都说成不切实际。

            用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府科研职责，说明资助研究时如何理解成果周期；并不据此推出应排除私营研究。

            no shortage of

            大量；不缺

            可以承认数字内容数量充足，再讨论数量之外的体验差异。

            用于写作：自编例句，直接回应线上娱乐与影院价值：先承认线上内容丰富，再解释共同观看体验这一文化维度。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Artificial Intelligence｜公共部门实施条件未作答选择题 / 选词摘要填空 · 3 段 · 223 词 · 5 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

            Q29：Choose A–D. Q30–33：Complete the summary using words A–I. 原选项完整保留。

            原文第4段We are now seeing governments pledge support to national AI initiatives and compete in a technological race to dominate the burgeoning machine-learning sector. While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

            原文第5段One of the most promising varieties of AI technologies are neural networks. This form of machine learning is loosely modelled on the neuronal structure of the human brain, but on a much smaller scale. But what many politicians do not understand is that simply adding a neural network to a problem will not automatically mean that you'll find a solution. Similarly, adding a neural network to a system of government does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair.

            原文第6段AI systems need a lot of data to function, but the public sector typically does not have the appropriate data infrastructure to support advanced machine learning. Most of the data remains stored in offline archives. The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy. More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed. Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

            共用选项 · 原题 30、31、32、33

            • A reliability
            • B funding
            • C skills
            • D prejudices
            • E computers
            • F equality
            • G framework
            • H confidentiality
            • I approval

            29. In the fourth paragraph, the writer suggests that many politicians may

            • A have failed to appreciate the true potential of AI initiatives.
            • B have misunderstood the function of the machine-learning sector.
            • C be unaware of the challenges of implementing national AI initiatives.
            • D be too keen to enter the race to dominate the machine-learning sector.

            30. Neural networks are a promising area of AI technology for governments. However, many politicians overestimate their capabilities, believing that the mere addition of a neural network will produce solutions and promote 30 __________.

            31. Most public sector organisations have not set up the necessary 31 __________ to manage the huge amount of data required to enable AI to function.

            32. Complex bureaucracy is another issue, as each person involved needs 32 __________ to access the relevant data, which is often spread across different departments.

            33. But the main problem is that few public sector employees have the 33 __________ to take full advantage of machine intelligence.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 29 题 · C

            unaware of challenges对应fail to realise complexity；国家竞争只是背景。

            they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world

            第 30 题 · F

            inclusive or fair概括为equality；注意摘要描述政治家过度期待，不是作者认可。

            does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair

            第 31 题 · G

            data infrastructure对应管理数据的framework，不只是computers。

            does not have the appropriate data infrastructure

            第 32 题 · I

            permissions对应approval；confidentiality是保密性，不是取得访问权。

            each require special permissions to be accessed

            第 33 题 · C

            capabilities概括为skills；Above all对应摘要main problem。

            lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这三段把AI的宏大承诺拉回公共部门的实施条件。先写政治热情与实际复杂性的落差，再解释神经网络不自动带来结果，最后列出数据、组织流程与人才等条件。它讨论的是技术部署的能力边界，不是说所有政府永远不能使用AI。

            原文第4段

            We are now seeing governments pledge support to national AI initiatives and compete in a technological race to dominate the burgeoning machine-learning sector. While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

            第4段写政府承诺支持国家AI项目，并争取在增长中的产业占据优势。While连接政治人物宣称的变革与作者指出的部署复杂性，重点在愿景与实施之间的距离。many限制为许多政治人物，不能扩大为全部。

            原文第5段

            One of the most promising varieties of AI technologies are neural networks. This form of machine learning is loosely modelled on the neuronal structure of the human brain, but on a much smaller scale. But what many politicians do not understand is that simply adding a neural network to a problem will not automatically mean that you'll find a solution. Similarly, adding a neural network to a system of government does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair.

            第5段介绍神经网络对人脑结构的松散模拟，loosely和on a much smaller scale都限制类比程度。接着指出，把神经网络加入某个问题或政府系统，不会自动意味着找到解决方案或立即获得公平与包容。否定的是自动、即时的效果，而不是说相关技术毫无用途。

            原文第6段

            AI systems need a lot of data to function, but the public sector typically does not have the appropriate data infrastructure to support advanced machine learning. Most of the data remains stored in offline archives. The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy. More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed. Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

            第6段把前段抽象的“复杂性”具体化：数据基础设施不足、资料仍离线、数字资料受行政流程阻碍、部门间访问需要权限，以及专业人才不足。typically、tend to和More often than not均表达常见倾向；Above all把人才放在作者强调的位置。

            词语与搭配

            pledge support to

            承诺支持……

            pledge是作出承诺，不等于支持措施已经落实或取得成效。

            loosely modelled on

            对……作松散的模拟

            be modelled on说明参考对象；loosely提示结构借鉴并不等于完整复制。

            appropriate data infrastructure

            合适的数据基础设施

            infrastructure是支持工作运行的基础系统；appropriate强调要符合实际用途，不是设备越多越好。

            buried in bureaucracy

            受繁琐行政程序阻碍，难以实际获取或使用

            buried是比喻，不表示资料真的埋在地下；需要结合数据访问的语境理解。

            reap the benefits of

            获得并享受到……的益处

            reap本义是收获；这里强调实际取得利益，与仅宣布使用某项技术不同。

            句子精读

            While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

            虽然许多政治人物宣扬即将到来的“AI革命”的变革效果，他们却没有认识到在现实世界部署先进机器学习系统的复杂性。

            While建立让步与转折；they回指many politicians。around deploying中的deploying是动名词，说明复杂性围绕何种实际工作产生。coming指被宣称即将到来的变化，不表明相关结果已经实现。

            Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

            尤其重要的是，公共部门通常缺乏具备合适技术能力的人才，因而难以充分获得机器智能的益处。

            Above all标出作者特别强调的条件。with the right technological capabilities修饰human talent，to fully reap...说明所需能力服务的目标；typically保留“通常”的范围，不能去掉后写成所有公共部门都没有人才。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            appropriate data infrastructure

            合适的数据基础设施

            适合具体说明公共科研投入的基础条件；搭配provide或develop时仍需交代研究用途。

            用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府资助具有公共价值、商业回报不确定的科研，具体化资金可以支持什么；不是说科研只能由政府执行。

            reap the benefits of

            实际获得……的益处

            后接能够说明来源的资源、经验或合作成果，避免只写空泛的benefits。

            用于写作：自编例句，直接回应政府与私企研究是否应排他：用有条件的合作说明可以利用不同主体的专业知识。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Artificial Intelligence｜部署边界、医疗与司法案例未作答观点判断 YNNG / 选词摘要填空 · 7 段 · 446 词 · 6 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

            Q36–39：YES / NO / NOT GIVEN。Q34–35：选词摘要填空，完整选项A–I保留。按原文顺序编排本段题组，原题号不变。全篇主旨Q40需阅读全文，未列入裁切。

            原文第7段For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics. Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots. Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.

            原文第8段One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks. This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions. Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms. Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.

            原文第9段If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society. This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.

            原文第10段Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead. Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.

            原文第11段The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI. The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer. Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine. As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.

            原文第12段Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals. An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing. The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.

            原文第13段There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes. These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything. Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it. All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.

            共用选项 · 原题 34、35

            • A reliability
            • B funding
            • C skills
            • D prejudices
            • E computers
            • F equality
            • G framework
            • H confidentiality
            • I approval

            36. Stuart Russell's proposals regarding the use of AI are impractical.

            37. Rodney Brooks' view has attracted unfair criticism from supporters of AI.

            38. Nowadays, the need to protect AI systems is always taken into account when they are set up.

            39. In order to benefit from AI and minimise the harms, we have to explore people's concerns about its use.

            34. The medical profession experimented with an AI programme, but their experts had little faith in its 34 __________, and the programme was abandoned.

            35. US courts also abandoned the use of algorithms when it was found that these reflected and magnified the existing 35 __________ within the legal profession.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 36 题 · NO

            作者赞成sensible and realistic，明确与impractical相反；无需评价Russell现实成就。

            a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI

            第 37 题 · NOT GIVEN

            全文只引用Brooks对部署耗时的判断，没有支持者如何回应他的观点，unfair更无依据。

            almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed

            第 38 题 · NO

            often overlooked直接反驳always taken into account；不是只缺少资料。

            AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed

            第 39 题 · YES

            concerns概括ethics与distrust；need to have a discussion支持have to explore。

            we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning

            第 34 题 · A

            hard to trust是对reliability的信任不足；不是缺钱funding。

            human experts found it hard to trust the machine

            第 35 题 · D

            amplify对应magnified，racial discrimination对应prejudices；没有说系统只缺技能。

            The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            后半篇从专家对宣传的批评转向安全、伦理与实际用途，再用医疗和司法例子说明部署限制，最后提出有选择地使用AI。作者要求把收益、潜在伤害和人的职责一并考虑，并未主张一律停止技术应用。具体项目经历均按本文叙述理解，不作为当前项目状态的独立核验。

            原文第7段

            For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics. Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots. Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.

            第7段承接前面关于实施困难的讨论，介绍两位研究者的观点：关注日常具体用途，并对广泛部署需要的时间保持现实认识。Brooks的引语谈“几乎所有创新”所需时间比想象长，不是说所有创新最终都会成功或永远无法部署。

            原文第8段

            One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks. This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions. Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms. Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.

            第8段解释对抗性攻击及相关安全问题：恶意AI可能使另一系统作出错误预测。研究者据此警告，在缺乏适当安全标准与防御机制时不应贸然推广。Still将已有警告与安全仍常被忽视的情况并置。

            原文第9段

            If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society. This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.

            第9段以“获得收益并减少潜在伤害”为目标，要求讨论AI在具体领域如何有意义地应用，同时考虑伦理和人们的不信任。meaningfully强调解决实际需要，而不是仅仅把技术放进某个场景。

            原文第10段

            Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead. Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.

            第10段进一步强调认识能力边界与人仍应主导的地方。take a step back是暂退一步冷静审视的比喻；separate...from...要求区分实际能力与幻想，不是说AI完全没有能力。

            原文第11段

            The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI. The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer. Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine. As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.

            第11段按本文叙述，以Watson肿瘤项目说明“设计上希望给出最佳建议”与“使用者实际建立信任”之间的距离。was meant to、developed to都表达目的，不能读成已经证实可靠。most hospitals where it was trialled限定为文中试用该项目的多数医院，不是所有医院或所有医疗AI。

            原文第12段

            Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals. An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing. The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.

            第12段按本文叙述，写一个在美国法院辅助量刑的算法放大结构性种族歧视并被弃用的例子。该段具体说明技术建议可能带来的社会后果；不能从这一系统的经历推出所有司法算法都有同一结果。

            原文第13段

            There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes. These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything. Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it. All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.

            第13段把前面的例子收束为选择使用范围的原则：技术本身不是使用理由，自动化也有成本，并非所有可以自动化的事都应该自动化。may not always与not every都是否定普遍保证，而不是断言AI在任何场景都无用。

            词语与搭配

            widely deployed

            得到广泛部署

            deploy在技术语境中指投入使用；widely描述应用范围，不能与实验成功或刚开发出来混同。

            appropriate security standards

            适当的安全标准

            appropriate强调与用途和风险相符的标准；有标准仍不自动意味着风险为零。

            minimise the potential harms

            尽量减少潜在伤害

            minimise指尽量降低，potential表示可能发生；两者都不同于保证完全消除伤害。

            be aware of the limitations of

            认识到……的局限

            limitations常接of说明对象；意识到局限可以帮助确定适用范围，不等于完全拒绝使用。

            simply for the sake of AI

            仅仅为了使用AI本身

            for the sake of可表示目的或理由；simply在这里批评没有实际需要支撑的技术采用。

            句子精读

            If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society.

            如果我们要获得AI的益处并尽量减少其潜在伤害，就必须开始思考机器学习怎样才能有意义地应用到政府、企业和社会的具体领域。

            If we are to...表达想实现的目标，must...提出作者认为必要的行动。reap与minimise并列，收益和伤害同时受到关注；how从句说明需要思考的是应用方式，specific areas限制讨论到具体领域。

            Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it.

            仅仅为了使用AI而使用AI，未必总是有成效或有用；也并非每个问题都最适合通过应用机器智能来处理。

            Using AI...是动名词主语；may not always保留“并非总是”的范围。not every issue是部分否定，不等于no issue。by applying...说明处理方式，it回指issue。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            minimise the potential harms

            尽量减少潜在伤害

            适合与审查、监管和试验条件相连；不能声称审查可以保证消除全部风险。

            用于写作：自编例句，直接回应科研应如何受到控制：提出可适用于公共和私营实验室的审查安排，不把监管等同于政府独占所有研究。

            be aware of the limitations of

            认识到……的局限

            后接具体技术或方法；认识边界服务于判断用途，避免演变成空泛反科技态度。

            用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府科研监督职责，把能力边界与是否批准扩大应用联系起来。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Miles Davis：独特音色、双重教育与音乐遗产未作答标题匹配 · 3 段 · 403 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            本材料也用于本册教学。已看过原文、示范或答案时，这次作答用于练习与复习，不作为未见题测试。

            官方样题 · British Council · Academic Practice Test 2 · Miles Davis · Q14–19 · PDF 第 1, 2 页

            Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings. Write the correct Roman numeral, i–ix. 本组保留原题号；同一标题不可重复使用。

            AAt the age of thirteen, Miles Davis was given his first trumpet, lessons were arranged with a local trumpet player, and a musical odyssey began. These early lessons, paid for and supported by his father, had a profound effect on shaping Davis’ signature sound. Whereas most trumpeters of the era favoured the use of vibrato (a wobbly quiver in pitch inflected in the instrument’s tone), Davis was taught to play with a long, straight tone, a preference his instructor reportedly drilled into the young trumpeter with a rap on the knuckles every time Davis began using vibrato. This clear, distinctive style never left Davis. He continued playing with it for the rest of his career, once remarking, ‘If I can’t get that sound, I can’t play anything.’

            BHaving graduated from high school in 1944, Davis moved to New York City, where he continued his musical education both in the clubs and in the classroom. His enrolment in the prestigious Julliard School of Music was short-lived, however – he soon dropped out, criticising what he perceived as an over-emphasis on the classical European repertoire and a neglect of jazz. Davis did later acknowledge, however, that this time at the school was invaluable in terms of developing his trumpet-playing technique and giving him a solid grounding in music theory. Much of his early training took place in the form of jam sessions and performances in the clubs of 52nd Street, where he played alongside both up- and-coming and established members of the jazz pantheon such as Coleman Hawkins, Eddie ‘Lockjaw’ Davis, and Thelonious Monk.

            CIn the late 1940s, Davis collaborated with nine other instrumentalists, including a French horn and a tuba player, to produce The Birth of Cool, an album now renowned for the inchoate sounds of what would later become known as ‘cool’ jazz. In contrast to popular jazz styles of the day, which featured rapid, rollicking beats, shrieking vocals, and short, sharp horn blasts, Davis’ album was the forerunner of a different kind of sound – thin, light horn-playing, hushed drums and a more restrained, formal arrangement. Although it received little acclaim at the time (the liner notes to one of Davis’ later recordings call it a ‘spectacular failure’), in hindsight The Birth of Cool has become recognised as a pivotal moment in jazz history, cementing – alongside his 1958 recording, Kind of Blue – Davis’ legacy as one of the most innovative musicians of his era.

            共用选项 · 原题 14、15、16

            • i. A legacy is established
            • ii. Formal education unhelpful
            • iii. An education in two parts
            • iv. Branching out in new directions
            • v. Childhood and family life
            • vi. Change necessary to stay creative
            • vii. Conflicted opinions over Davis’ earlier work
            • viii. Davis’ unique style of trumpet playing
            • ix. Personal and professional struggles

            14. Paragraph A

            15. Paragraph B

            16. Paragraph C

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 14 题 · viii

            父亲和13岁是背景，核心是独特的straight tone及其终身保留，故v childhood太宽且偏离主旨。

            These early lessons, paid for and supported by his father, had a profound effect on shaping Davis’ signature sound.

            第 15 题 · iii

            课堂与俱乐部是两部分。虽然退学并批评学校，后来仍承认理论与技巧训练有价值，不能选ii。

            he continued his musical education both in the clubs and in the classroom.

            第 16 题 · i

            先写创新风格，再写当时失败、后来历史认可，段落落点是确立legacy，不是只谈当时意见分歧。

            Davis’ legacy as one of the most innovative musicians of his era.

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这三段沿着音色形成、学习经历和录音创作展开，解释戴维斯的独特风格怎样产生，以及一部当时反响冷淡的作品如何在后来获得历史地位。个人风格、不同学习环境与作品接受史是相互关联的三条线。

            A

            At the age of thirteen, Miles Davis was given his first trumpet, lessons were arranged with a local trumpet player, and a musical odyssey began. These early lessons, paid for and supported by his father, had a profound effect on shaping Davis’ signature sound. Whereas most trumpeters of the era favoured the use of vibrato (a wobbly quiver in pitch inflected in the instrument’s tone), Davis was taught to play with a long, straight tone, a preference his instructor reportedly drilled into the young trumpeter with a rap on the knuckles every time Davis began using vibrato. This clear, distinctive style never left Davis. He continued playing with it for the rest of his career, once remarking, ‘If I can’t get that sound, I can’t play anything.’

            A段从十三岁获得小号写起。父亲资助的课程塑造了他的标志性音色：当时许多演奏者偏爱颤音，他的老师却训练他保持悠长、平直的音。后来的自述表明，这种音色成为他认同自身演奏的基础。原文描述老师敲打指关节的做法，是人物经历，不是认可这种教学方式。

            B

            Having graduated from high school in 1944, Davis moved to New York City, where he continued his musical education both in the clubs and in the classroom. His enrolment in the prestigious Julliard School of Music was short-lived, however – he soon dropped out, criticising what he perceived as an over-emphasis on the classical European repertoire and a neglect of jazz. Davis did later acknowledge, however, that this time at the school was invaluable in terms of developing his trumpet-playing technique and giving him a solid grounding in music theory. Much of his early training took place in the form of jam sessions and performances in the clubs of 52nd Street, where he played alongside both up- and-coming and established members of the jazz pantheon such as Coleman Hawkins, Eddie ‘Lockjaw’ Davis, and Thelonious Monk.

            B段把音乐教育分为学校课堂和俱乐部两种环境。戴维斯不满学校偏重欧洲古典曲目、忽视爵士，因而退学；但他后来仍肯定学校对小号技巧和乐理基础的帮助。与新秀和成名乐手同台的经历，则提供了课堂之外的实践。两种学习来源并非互相排斥。

            C

            In the late 1940s, Davis collaborated with nine other instrumentalists, including a French horn and a tuba player, to produce The Birth of Cool, an album now renowned for the inchoate sounds of what would later become known as ‘cool’ jazz. In contrast to popular jazz styles of the day, which featured rapid, rollicking beats, shrieking vocals, and short, sharp horn blasts, Davis’ album was the forerunner of a different kind of sound – thin, light horn-playing, hushed drums and a more restrained, formal arrangement. Although it received little acclaim at the time (the liner notes to one of Davis’ later recordings call it a ‘spectacular failure’), in hindsight The Birth of Cool has become recognised as a pivotal moment in jazz history, cementing – alongside his 1958 recording, Kind of Blue – Davis’ legacy as one of the most innovative musicians of his era.

            C段将前面的个人风格推进到合作录音。他与其他乐器演奏者创造了较轻、克制、编排更正式的声音，与当时流行的急促节拍和强烈音响形成对照。作品当时缺少赞誉，后来却被视为爵士史的重要转折。in hindsight明确区分当时反响与后来的评价。

            词语与搭配

            had a profound effect on

            对……产生深远影响

            have an effect on后接受到影响的人、事或过程；profound强调影响深而持久，此处具体指早期课程塑造音色。

            a solid grounding in music theory

            扎实的乐理基础

            grounding表示作为后续学习或实践基础的知识训练，常与in搭配；不是地面或被禁足的意思。

            In contrast to

            与……形成对照

            后接名词性成分，此处引出当时流行爵士与新录音在声音上的差异，不表示其中一方天然更好。

            in hindsight

            事后回看；从后来的认识看

            用于区分经历发生时与后来回顾时的理解；不能把后来获得的评价写成当时已经普遍接受。

            句子精读

            Whereas most trumpeters of the era favoured the use of vibrato (a wobbly quiver in pitch inflected in the instrument’s tone), Davis was taught to play with a long, straight tone, a preference his instructor reportedly drilled into the young trumpeter with a rap on the knuckles every time Davis began using vibrato.

            当时大多数小号演奏者喜欢运用颤音，即乐器音色中音高的颤动；戴维斯却被教导使用悠长、平直的音。据说，每当他开始使用颤音时，老师就敲一下他的指关节，以此把这种偏好灌输给他。

            Whereas引出对照；括号解释vibrato。a preference补充说明前面的演奏取向，his instructor reportedly drilled into...说明训练方式；reportedly表明这一细节来自转述。every time引出每次发生的情形。

            Davis did later acknowledge, however, that this time at the school was invaluable in terms of developing his trumpet-playing technique and giving him a solid grounding in music theory.

            不过，戴维斯后来确实承认，在这所学校的经历对发展他的小号演奏技巧、打下扎实的乐理基础非常宝贵。

            did强调他确实作过这一肯定；that引出承认的内容。in terms of后面developing和giving并列，指出两方面价值。this time指在学校学习的这段经历，不能因他退学就把学校贡献一并否定。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            a solid grounding in music theory

            扎实的乐理基础

            可说明专业理论如何支持实践；不把理论学习与工作实习写成只能二选一。

            用于写作：自编例句，适用于本科课程是否应包括实习：音乐专业作为具体例子，说明已有理论知识怎样在工作环境中应用；不代表所有专业都需要录音棚实习。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Miles Davis：困境、跨界与创造力未作答标题匹配 · 3 段 · 364 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            官方样题 · British Council · Academic Practice Test 2 · Miles Davis · Q14–19 · PDF 第 1, 2 页

            Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings. Write the correct Roman numeral, i–ix. 本组保留原题号；同一标题不可重复使用。

            DThough Davis’ trumpet playing may have sounded effortless and breezy, this ease rarely carried over into the rest of his life. The early 1950s, in particular, were a time of great personal turmoil. After returning from a stint in Paris, Davis suffered from prolonged depression, which he attributed to the unravelling of a number of relationships, including his romance with a French actress and some musical partnerships that ruptured as a result of creative disputes. Davis was also frustrated by his perception that he had been overlooked by the music critics, who were hailing the success of his collaborators and descendants in the ‘cool’ tradition, such as Gerry Mulligan and Dave Brubeck, but who afforded him little credit for introducing the cool sound in the first place.

            EIn the latter decades of his career, Davis broke out of exclusive jazz settings and began to diversify his output across a range of musical styles. In the 1960s, he was influenced by early funk performers such as Sly and the Family Stone, which then expanded into the jazz-rock fusion genre – of which he was a frontrunner – in the 1970s. Electronic recording effects and electric instruments were incorporated into his sound. By the 1980s, Davis was pushing the boundaries further, covering pop anthems such as Cyndi Lauper’s Time After Time and Michael Jackson’s Human Nature, dabbling in hip hop, and even appearing in some movies.

            FNot everyone was supportive of Davis’ change of tune. Compared to the recordings of his early career, universally applauded as linchpins of the jazz oeuvre, trumpeter Wynston Marsalis derided his fusion work as being ‘not true jazz’, and pianist Bill Evans denounced the ‘corrupting influence’ of record companies, noting that rock and pop ‘draw wider audiences’. In the face of this criticism Davis remained defiant, commenting that his earlier recordings were part of a moment in time that he had no ‘feel’ for any more. He firmly believed that remaining stylistically inert would have hampered his ability to develop new ways of producing music. From this perspective, Davis’ continual revamping of genre was not merely a rebellion, but an evolution, a necessary path that allowed him to release his full musical potential.

            共用选项 · 原题 17、18、19

            • i. A legacy is established
            • ii. Formal education unhelpful
            • iii. An education in two parts
            • iv. Branching out in new directions
            • v. Childhood and family life
            • vi. Change necessary to stay creative
            • vii. Conflicted opinions over Davis’ earlier work
            • viii. Davis’ unique style of trumpet playing
            • ix. Personal and professional struggles

            17. Paragraph D

            18. Paragraph E

            19. Paragraph F

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 17 题 · ix

            关系破裂属个人困境，音乐合作冲突和被评论家忽视属职业困境，两半共同满足ix。

            his romance with a French actress and some musical partnerships that ruptured as a result of creative disputes.

            第 18 题 · iv

            funk→fusion→pop→hip hop是扩展音乐方向，年份本身不是主旨。

            began to diversify his output across a range of musical styles.

            第 19 题 · vi

            批评是引入，末句说明变化释放音乐潜能；重点是为何必须变化而非只列别人不赞成。

            remaining stylistically inert would have hampered his ability to develop new ways of producing music.

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这三段把听起来轻松的音乐与并不轻松的人生并置，继而写风格跨界引起的争论。结尾从戴维斯自己的创作观解释变化：继续发展对他比维持旧风格更重要。

            D

            Though Davis’ trumpet playing may have sounded effortless and breezy, this ease rarely carried over into the rest of his life. The early 1950s, in particular, were a time of great personal turmoil. After returning from a stint in Paris, Davis suffered from prolonged depression, which he attributed to the unravelling of a number of relationships, including his romance with a French actress and some musical partnerships that ruptured as a result of creative disputes. Davis was also frustrated by his perception that he had been overlooked by the music critics, who were hailing the success of his collaborators and descendants in the ‘cool’ tradition, such as Gerry Mulligan and Dave Brubeck, but who afforded him little credit for introducing the cool sound in the first place.

            D段先区分演奏给人的轻松感与个人生活。文中把五十年代初的抑郁与人际、合作关系破裂联系起来，同时交代他认为评论界忽视了自己的贡献。which he attributed to与his perception都保留了当事人的解释和感受，不能改写成已经独立证实的全部成因。

            E

            In the latter decades of his career, Davis broke out of exclusive jazz settings and began to diversify his output across a range of musical styles. In the 1960s, he was influenced by early funk performers such as Sly and the Family Stone, which then expanded into the jazz-rock fusion genre – of which he was a frontrunner – in the 1970s. Electronic recording effects and electric instruments were incorporated into his sound. By the 1980s, Davis was pushing the boundaries further, covering pop anthems such as Cyndi Lauper’s Time After Time and Michael Jackson’s Human Nature, dabbling in hip hop, and even appearing in some movies.

            E段按年代呈现创作范围的扩展：放克影响、爵士与摇滚融合、电子效果和电声乐器，随后涉及流行歌曲、嘻哈和电影。diversify不是放弃音乐，而是让创作跨越更多风格。段落为下一段的批评提供具体背景。

            F

            Not everyone was supportive of Davis’ change of tune. Compared to the recordings of his early career, universally applauded as linchpins of the jazz oeuvre, trumpeter Wynston Marsalis derided his fusion work as being ‘not true jazz’, and pianist Bill Evans denounced the ‘corrupting influence’ of record companies, noting that rock and pop ‘draw wider audiences’. In the face of this criticism Davis remained defiant, commenting that his earlier recordings were part of a moment in time that he had no ‘feel’ for any more. He firmly believed that remaining stylistically inert would have hampered his ability to develop new ways of producing music. From this perspective, Davis’ continual revamping of genre was not merely a rebellion, but an evolution, a necessary path that allowed him to release his full musical potential.

            F段呈现对跨界的不同判断：有人认为融合不是真正的爵士，也有人把变化归因于唱片公司的商业影响。戴维斯则说，早期作品属于自己已没有同样感受的过去；原地不动会限制创作。结尾的From this perspective限定了“演进而非仅仅叛逆”这一评价的观察角度。

            词语与搭配

            carried over into

            延续到；影响到另一领域

            carry over强调一种状态从原来的范围延伸出去；此处否定音乐的轻松感同样存在于他的生活中。

            diversify his output

            使自己的作品类型多样化

            output在此指创作产出；diversify强调种类和方向增加，不等于每种尝试都得到肯定。

            draw wider audiences

            吸引范围更广的观众

            draw在此是吸引；wider侧重覆盖面更广，不能据此推断作品艺术价值高低。

            In the face of this criticism

            面对这些批评

            in the face of可接困难、反对等；this criticism回指对跨界作品及商业影响的批评。

            句子精读

            Though Davis’ trumpet playing may have sounded effortless and breezy, this ease rarely carried over into the rest of his life.

            虽然戴维斯的小号演奏可能听起来轻松自在，但这种轻松感很少延续到他生活的其他方面。

            Though引出让步；may have sounded描述听众可能获得的听觉印象，而非断言演奏过程毫不费力。this ease承接effortless and breezy的感受，rarely限制延续发生的频率。

            He firmly believed that remaining stylistically inert would have hampered his ability to develop new ways of producing music.

            他坚信，如果风格一直停滞不变，就会妨碍他发展新的音乐创作方式。

            He指戴维斯。remaining stylistically inert是动名词结构，充当宾语从句的主语；would have hampered表达他对未选择的停滞状态的判断。句子陈述他的信念，不是关于所有艺术家的普遍定律。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            draw wider audiences

            吸引范围更广的观众

            可具体说明线上娱乐的可达性；观众范围扩大不等于线下场所失去全部文化价值。

            用于写作：自编例句，直接回应线上娱乐的覆盖范围优势；can和especially保留条件，也为讨论剧院独有的现场体验留下空间。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Older workers：薪资条件与两种继续工作的动机未作答选择题 · 4 段 · 412 词 · 4 题

            官方样题 · IELTS.org Academic Reading Sample Tasks 2023 · Older workers · Q1–4 · PDF 第 1, 2 页

            Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D. Write the correct letter in boxes 1–4.

            1The general assumption is that older workers are paid more in spite of, rather than because of, their productivity. That might partly explain why, when employers are under pressure to cut costs, they persuade a 55-year old to take early retirement. Take away seniority-based pay scales, and older workers may become a much more attractive employment proposition. But most employers and many workers are uncomfortable with the idea of reducing someone’s pay in later life – although manual workers on piece-rates often earn less as they get older. So retaining the services of older workers may mean employing them in different ways.

            2One innovation was devised by IBM Belgium. Faced with the need to cut staff costs, and having decided to concentrate cuts on 55 to 60-year olds, IBM set up a separate company called Skill Team, which re-employed any of the early retired who wanted to go on working up to the age of 60. An employee who joined Skill Team at the age of 55 on a five-year contract would work for 58% of his time, over the full period, for 88% of his last IBM salary. The company offered services to IBM, thus allowing it to retain access to some of the intellectual capital it would otherwise have lost.

            3The best way to tempt the old to go on working may be to build on such ‘bridge’ jobs: part- time or temporary employment that creates a more gradual transition from full-time work to retirement. Studies have found that, in the United States, nearly half of all men and women who had been in full-time jobs in middle age moved into such ‘bridge’ jobs at the end of their working lives. In general, it is the best-paid and worst-paid who carry on working. There seem to be two very different types of bridge job-holder – those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to, even though they could afford to retire.

            4If the job market grows more flexible, the old may find more jobs that suit them. Often, they will be self-employed. Sometimes, they may start their own businesses: a study by David Storey of Warwick University found that in Britain 70% of businesses started by people over 55 survived, compared with an overall national average of only 19%. But whatever pattern of employment they choose, in the coming years the skills of these ‘grey workers’ will have to be increasingly acknowledged and rewarded.

            1. In paragraph one, the writer suggests that companies could consider

            • A. abolishing pay schemes that are based on age.
            • B. avoiding pay that is based on piece-rates.
            • C. increasing pay for older workers.
            • D. equipping older workers with new skills.

            2. Skill Team is an example of a company which

            • A. offers older workers increases in salary.
            • B. allows people to continue working for as long as they want.
            • C. allows the expertise of older workers to be put to use.
            • D. treats older and younger workers equally.

            3. According to the writer, ‘bridge’ jobs

            • A. tend to attract people in middle-salary ranges.
            • B. are better paid than some full-time jobs.
            • C. originated in the United States.
            • D. appeal to distinct groups of older workers.

            4. David Storey’s study found that

            • A. people demand more from their work as they get older.
            • B. older people are good at running their own businesses.
            • C. an increasing number of old people are self-employed.
            • D. few young people have their own businesses.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 1 题 · A

            建议取消按资历定薪的制度。piece-rates只用作反例，不是作者建议废除它。

            Take away seniority-based pay scales, and older workers may become a much more attractive employment proposition.

            第 2 题 · C

            保留经验和知识正对应expertise。88%不是加薪，工作到60岁不是想多久就多久。

            thus allowing it to retain access to some of the intellectual capital it would otherwise have lost.

            第 3 题 · D

            两类人的动机不同，D概括distinct groups。美国研究发生地不能推出起源于美国，最佳和最差薪酬者也不等于中间薪资。

            those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to

            第 4 题 · B

            较高企业存活比例支持经营表现，未给自雇人数随时间增多趋势或年轻人拥有企业的比例。

            70% of businesses started by people over 55 survived, compared with an overall national average of only 19%.

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            文章讨论怎样保留年长劳动者的经验。先提出薪资和成本之间的矛盾，再用公司安排说明替代雇用方式，随后解释渐进退休的不同动机，最后展望更灵活的就业形式。文中的研究数字属于材料所述研究，不能外推为当前各国的普遍比例。

            1

            The general assumption is that older workers are paid more in spite of, rather than because of, their productivity. That might partly explain why, when employers are under pressure to cut costs, they persuade a 55-year old to take early retirement. Take away seniority-based pay scales, and older workers may become a much more attractive employment proposition. But most employers and many workers are uncomfortable with the idea of reducing someone’s pay in later life – although manual workers on piece-rates often earn less as they get older. So retaining the services of older workers may mean employing them in different ways.

            第1段先报告一种常见假设：年长者收入较高未必由生产率解释。might partly把它限制为雇主推动提前退休的部分可能原因。取消按资历加薪或降低晚年薪酬并非没有阻力，因此段末转向改变雇用方式，而不是简单地要求降薪。

            2

            One innovation was devised by IBM Belgium. Faced with the need to cut staff costs, and having decided to concentrate cuts on 55 to 60-year olds, IBM set up a separate company called Skill Team, which re-employed any of the early retired who wanted to go on working up to the age of 60. An employee who joined Skill Team at the age of 55 on a five-year contract would work for 58% of his time, over the full period, for 88% of his last IBM salary. The company offered services to IBM, thus allowing it to retain access to some of the intellectual capital it would otherwise have lost.

            第2段以IBM Belgium的Skill Team安排具体化这种改变：部分提前退休者通过另设公司继续工作；文中五年合同的58%工时和88%原薪酬是这一安排的条件。服务继续提供给IBM，使它保留本来可能流失的知识经验。

            3

            The best way to tempt the old to go on working may be to build on such ‘bridge’ jobs: part- time or temporary employment that creates a more gradual transition from full-time work to retirement. Studies have found that, in the United States, nearly half of all men and women who had been in full-time jobs in middle age moved into such ‘bridge’ jobs at the end of their working lives. In general, it is the best-paid and worst-paid who carry on working. There seem to be two very different types of bridge job-holder – those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to, even though they could afford to retire.

            第3段把个案扩展到“桥梁工作”，即帮助人从全职工作逐步过渡到退休的兼职或临时工作。继续工作的人包括收入较高和较低的两端，背后可能分别是愿意工作和必须维持收入；两者不能混为同一种选择。

            4

            If the job market grows more flexible, the old may find more jobs that suit them. Often, they will be self-employed. Sometimes, they may start their own businesses: a study by David Storey of Warwick University found that in Britain 70% of businesses started by people over 55 survived, compared with an overall national average of only 19%. But whatever pattern of employment they choose, in the coming years the skills of these ‘grey workers’ will have to be increasingly acknowledged and rewarded.

            第4段用条件句讨论更灵活的市场可能带来的机会，包括自雇和创业。英国特定研究中的企业存活比例用于支撑年长创业者可能拥有的能力，不等于他们在所有条件下都更成功。结尾强调无论采用何种形式，其技能都需要被承认并获得回报。

            词语与搭配

            under pressure to cut costs

            承受削减成本的压力

            under pressure to后接动作，说明压力指向什么；不等于已经完成削减。

            retain access to

            保留获得或使用……的渠道

            retain强调继续拥有；文中指IBM仍能利用原员工的知识，不是把这些人视作公司所有物。

            a more gradual transition

            更为逐步的过渡

            transition常与from...to...连接起点和终点；gradual描述过程速度，不自动等于对每个人都更合适。

            could afford to retire

            在经济上能够承担退休

            afford to指具备承受某种选择的资源；此处与因经济需要必须继续工作的人形成区别。

            句子精读

            Faced with the need to cut staff costs, and having decided to concentrate cuts on 55 to 60-year olds, IBM set up a separate company called Skill Team, which re-employed any of the early retired who wanted to go on working up to the age of 60.

            IBM面对削减员工成本的需要，并且已经决定把削减集中在55至60岁员工身上，于是设立了名为Skill Team的独立公司，重新雇用那些提前退休后仍希望继续工作到60岁的人。

            Faced with...和having decided...共同补充IBM的背景，后者表示先作出的决定；which指Skill Team。who限定愿意继续工作的提前退休者，并非所有提前退休员工都会自动加入。

            There seem to be two very different types of bridge job-holder – those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to, even though they could afford to retire.

            桥梁工作从业者似乎有两种很不相同的类型：一类因为不得不工作而继续，另一类即使经济上能够退休，也因为自己愿意而继续工作。

            There seem to be保留概括的审慎程度；两个those who...并列。have to与want to区分必要性和意愿，even though引出第二类人的让步条件。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            蜣螂隧道：用深度和形状读图未作答图示标注 · 3 段 · 338 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            官方样题 · Cambridge Academic Reading official sample · Dung beetles · PDF 第 1, 2 页

            Label the tunnels on the diagram below using words from the box. Write your answers in boxes 6–8. 按原图位置作答，词框完整保留。

            原官方样题完整保留连续三段，图示与下一组表格为同篇材料的不同正式题组，不计作两篇独立原文。

            1Introducing dung beetles into a pasture is a simple process: approximately 1,500 beetles are released, a handful at a time, into fresh cow pats in the cow pasture. The beetles immediately disappear beneath the pats digging and tunnelling and, if they successfully adapt to their new environment, soon become a permanent, self-sustaining part of the local ecology. In time they multiply and within three or four years the benefits to the pasture are obvious.

            2Dung beetles work from the inside of the pat so they are sheltered from predators such as birds and foxes. Most species burrow into the soil and bury dung in tunnels directly underneath the pats, which are hollowed out from within. Some large species originating from France excavate tunnels to a depth of approximately 30 cm below the dung pat. These beetles make sausage-shaped brood chambers along the tunnels. The shallowest tunnels belong to a much smaller Spanish species that buries dung in chambers that hang like fruit from the branches of a pear tree. South African beetles dig narrow tunnels of approximately 20 cm below the surface of the pat. Some surface-dwelling beetles, including a South African species, cut perfectly-shaped balls from the pat, which are rolled away and attached to the bases of plants.

            3For maximum dung burial in spring, summer and autumn, farmers require a variety of species with overlapping periods of activity. In the cooler environments of the state of Victoria, the large French species (2.5 cms long), is matched with smaller (half this size), temperate-climate Spanish species. The former are slow to recover from the winter cold and produce only one or two generations of offspring from late spring until autumn. The latter, which multiply rapidly in early spring, produce two to five generations annually. The South African ball-rolling species, being a sub-tropical beetle, prefers the climate of northern and coastal New South Wales where it commonly works with the South African tunneling species. In warmer climates, many species are active for longer periods of the year.

            原题 Glossary：dung — the droppings or excreta of animals

            原题 Glossary：cow pats — droppings of cows

            共用选项 · 原题 6、7、8

            • French
            • Spanish
            • Mediterranean
            • South African
            • Australian native
            • South African ball roller

            6. 原图标号6所指隧道的种类

            7. 原图标号7所指隧道的种类

            8. 原图标号8所指隧道的种类

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 6 题 · South African

            左侧隧道约20cm，匹配South African；ball roller把球滚离粪堆，不能因同国别选它。

            South African beetles dig narrow tunnels of approximately 20 cm below the surface of the pat.

            第 7 题 · French

            中间最深约30cm，与French对应，sausage-shaped chambers补充形状证据。

            Some large species originating from France excavate tunnels to a depth of approximately 30 cm below the dung pat.

            第 8 题 · Spanish

            右侧最浅且分叉如梨树，matching shallowest；不是用甲虫体长当隧道深度。

            The shallowest tunnels belong to a much smaller Spanish species

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这段材料先写蜣螂如何被引入牧场，再从地下隧道、育幼室和滚粪球的位置解释不同工作方式，最后把物种差异联系到季节配合。理解重点是条件、空间关系和形态之间的联系。

            1

            Introducing dung beetles into a pasture is a simple process: approximately 1,500 beetles are released, a handful at a time, into fresh cow pats in the cow pasture. The beetles immediately disappear beneath the pats digging and tunnelling and, if they successfully adapt to their new environment, soon become a permanent, self-sustaining part of the local ecology. In time they multiply and within three or four years the benefits to the pasture are obvious.

            第1段说明引入过程及建立种群的条件：把甲虫少量分批放入新鲜牛粪后，它们会向下挖掘；只有成功适应新环境，才会形成能自行维持的本地生态组成。三四年后收益明显是文中描述的时间尺度，不能略去适应条件。

            2

            Dung beetles work from the inside of the pat so they are sheltered from predators such as birds and foxes. Most species burrow into the soil and bury dung in tunnels directly underneath the pats, which are hollowed out from within. Some large species originating from France excavate tunnels to a depth of approximately 30 cm below the dung pat. These beetles make sausage-shaped brood chambers along the tunnels. The shallowest tunnels belong to a much smaller Spanish species that buries dung in chambers that hang like fruit from the branches of a pear tree. South African beetles dig narrow tunnels of approximately 20 cm below the surface of the pat. Some surface-dwelling beetles, including a South African species, cut perfectly-shaped balls from the pat, which are rolled away and attached to the bases of plants.

            第2段从共同的遮蔽位置写到不同物种的挖掘形态：法国种向下挖约30厘米并形成香肠状育幼室；西班牙种较浅，育幼室如树枝上悬挂的果实；南非种既有挖窄隧道的，也有把粪球滚离粪堆并固定在植物基部的。文中的形状比喻帮助理解位置，不表示真的长成果实。

            3

            For maximum dung burial in spring, summer and autumn, farmers require a variety of species with overlapping periods of activity. In the cooler environments of the state of Victoria, the large French species (2.5 cms long), is matched with smaller (half this size), temperate-climate Spanish species. The former are slow to recover from the winter cold and produce only one or two generations of offspring from late spring until autumn. The latter, which multiply rapidly in early spring, produce two to five generations annually. The South African ball-rolling species, being a sub-tropical beetle, prefers the climate of northern and coastal New South Wales where it commonly works with the South African tunneling species. In warmer climates, many species are active for longer periods of the year.

            第3段说明农民为什么需要活动期重叠的多种甲虫：法国种从冬季恢复较慢，西班牙种早春繁殖较快，二者配合可延长处理粪便的季节覆盖；亚热带的南非滚粪球种适应较暖区域。former和latter分别回指前面的法国种与西班牙种。

            词语与搭配

            adapt to their new environment

            适应它们的新环境

            adapt to后接名词性环境；这里是种群能否建立的条件，而不是释放后必然成功。

            a permanent, self-sustaining part

            一个长期存在、能自行维持的组成部分

            self-sustaining指能够维持自身延续；不能由此推出对生态的一切影响都无须观察。

            to a depth of approximately 30 cm

            达到约30厘米的深度

            to a depth of表示向下到达的深度；approximately保留近似性，文中起算位置是牛粪堆之下。

            overlapping periods of activity

            相互重叠的活动期
