            overlapping表示时间有交集，不表示所有物种全年同时活动。

            句子精读

            The beetles immediately disappear beneath the pats digging and tunnelling and, if they successfully adapt to their new environment, soon become a permanent, self-sustaining part of the local ecology.

            甲虫立即钻到牛粪堆下面挖掘、开辟隧道；如果成功适应新环境，它们很快就会成为当地生态中长期存在、能够自行维持的一部分。

            digging and tunnelling补充甲虫钻入后进行的动作；if从句限定后面的become。they两次都指引入的甲虫，不能把“立刻钻入”与“长期建立种群”当成同一时间、同一确定程度的结果。

            The latter, which multiply rapidly in early spring, produce two to five generations annually.

            后者，也就是西班牙物种，在早春迅速繁殖，每年产生两至五代后代。

            The latter回指与法国种并列的西班牙种；which从句补充早春繁殖快的特点。annually修饰一年内产生的代数，不是说每次繁殖都产生两至五代。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            产品召回：批次、退款与联系人未作答短答题 · 5 段 · 223 词 · 5 题

            官方样题 · Cambridge General Training Reading official sample · Product return · PDF 第 1 页

            Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer. Write your answers in boxes 4–8.

            1Fancy Foods wishes to inform the public that pieces of metal have been found in some jars of Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Spicy). The batches of the jars involved have numbers from J6617 to J6624. The batch number is printed on the bottom of each jar.

            2If you have any jars with these batch numbers, please return them (preferably unopened) to the supermarket where you purchased them. You can also return them to the factory (Fancy Foods Retailers, Blacktown). Fancy Foods will pay $10 for each jar returned unopened and $5 for each jar already opened.

            3No payment will be made for empty jars, which do not need to be returned. However, the Retailing Manager will be interested to hear from people who have consumed chicken curry from any of the above batch numbers. In particular, it will be helpful if they can give information about the place of purchase of the product.

            4Jars of Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Coconut) and Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Mango) have not been affected and do not need to be returned.

            5Fancy Foods will pay a reward of $10,000 to $50,000 for information which leads to the conviction of any person found guilty of placing metal pieces in its products. If you have such information, please contact the Customer Relations Manager, Fancy Foods Retailers, Blacktown.

            4. What has been found in some Fancy Foods products?

            5. Where can you find the batch number on the jars?

            6. How much will you receive for an opened jar of contaminated Chicken Curry?

            7. If you have eaten Chicken Curry from a jar with one of the batch numbers listed, whom should you contact?

            8. What is the maximum reward Fancy Foods is offering for information about who contaminated their product?

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 4 题 · pieces of metal

            第 5 题 · the bottom；on the bottom

            是罐底，不是退货地点supermarket。

            The batch number is printed on the bottom of each jar.

            第 6 题 · $5

            opened与unopened对应两种金额，empty则不给钱。

            $10 for each jar returned unopened and $5 for each jar already opened.

            第 7 题 · Retailing Manager；the Retailing Manager

            吃过产品找Retailing Manager；提供谁投放金属的线索找Customer Relations Manager，勿交换两个身份。

            the Retailing Manager will be interested to hear from people who have consumed chicken curry

            第 8 题 · $50,000

            maximum取区间上限，不能取首次看到的10,000。

            a reward of $10,000 to $50,000

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这是一份按适用范围、退回处理、特殊情形和线索联络组织的产品召回告示。准确理解对象和条件，比把所有罐装咖喱视为同一种情况更重要。金额、产品名和联络人均属于本材料中的告示，不作为现实召回指引。

            1

            Fancy Foods wishes to inform the public that pieces of metal have been found in some jars of Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Spicy). The batches of the jars involved have numbers from J6617 to J6624. The batch number is printed on the bottom of each jar.

            第1段交代发现问题的产品是Spicy口味的部分罐装咖喱，涉及批号J6617至J6624，批号位于罐底。some与明确批号把范围限定住，不能扩大到该品牌所有产品。

            2

            If you have any jars with these batch numbers, please return them (preferably unopened) to the supermarket where you purchased them. You can also return them to the factory (Fancy Foods Retailers, Blacktown). Fancy Foods will pay $10 for each jar returned unopened and $5 for each jar already opened.

            第2段说明持有这些批号产品的人可退到购买超市或工厂，preferably unopened表示最好未开封，并非已经开封就不能退。未开封每罐10美元、已开封每罐5美元是两个不同条件。

            3

            No payment will be made for empty jars, which do not need to be returned. However, the Retailing Manager will be interested to hear from people who have consumed chicken curry from any of the above batch numbers. In particular, it will be helpful if they can give information about the place of purchase of the product.

            第3段单独处理已经吃完的情况：空罐不退款、也不必退回，但吃过有关批次产品的人仍可向零售经理提供信息，尤其是购买地点。没有退款不等于其反馈没有价值。

            4

            Jars of Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Coconut) and Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Mango) have not been affected and do not need to be returned.

            第4段明确Coconut和Mango两种口味未受影响，无须退回；这与第一段指定Spicy口味共同界定召回边界。

            5

            Fancy Foods will pay a reward of $10,000 to $50,000 for information which leads to the conviction of any person found guilty of placing metal pieces in its products. If you have such information, please contact the Customer Relations Manager, Fancy Foods Retailers, Blacktown.

            第5段转为征集导致涉案人员被定罪的线索，奖金范围与普通退货退款不同。此处联络的是客户关系经理，不能与前面接收已食用产品信息的零售经理混同。

            词语与搭配

            wishes to inform the public

            谨此告知公众

            正式告示中礼貌地引出通知内容；wish to并非表示消息还没有发生。

            preferably unopened

            最好尚未开封

            preferably表达优先选择，不是必须满足的绝对条件。

            the place of purchase

            购买地点

            purchase在这里是购买这一行为，place of说明行为发生地点。

            leads to the conviction

            促成定罪

            lead to后接名词；conviction此处是司法定罪，不是个人的坚定信念。

            句子精读

            If you have any jars with these batch numbers, please return them (preferably unopened) to the supermarket where you purchased them.

            如果你持有任何标有这些批号的罐装产品，请把它们退回购买它们的超市，最好保持未开封状态。

            If从句限定指令适用的人；these batch numbers回指前段范围。them指相关罐装产品；where引出修饰the supermarket的地点关系。括号中的preferably是偏好条件。

            No payment will be made for empty jars, which do not need to be returned.

            空罐不予退款，而且也无须退回。

            主句的被动语态把重点放在退款安排；which补充说明empty jars，do not need to表示没有退回的必要，不是禁止退回。两项安排只适用于空罐。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Saving the saiga · 生存适应与早期数量变化未作答笔记填空 / 事实判断 TFNG · 4 段 · 340 词 · 7 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 61 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            数字和相对时间均保留原考试文章语境；同篇其他裁切不另计为一篇原文。

            原文片段 · 1The saiga, a species of antelope native to Central Asia, once roamed the vast grasslands of this region in enormous herds, many millions strong. Regrettably, such spectacular sights are a thing of the past. Today, the saiga is largely confined to a single country: Kazakhstan. This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.

            原文片段 · 2The saiga is perfectly adapted to the tough conditions of the remote wilderness of the steppes of Central Asia. One such adaptation is its bizarre bulbous nose, which enables the animal to survive the extreme seasonal temperature swings of the region. The swollen nostrils of the nose serve several purposes: they filter out dust and cool the blood during hot, dry summers, and they warm the cold air before it enters the saiga's lungs in winter. Other seasonal adaptations include a heavy winter coat that the saiga sheds when the weather warms up.

            原文片段 · 3Despite these superb adaptations to harsh conditions, the saiga has no defence against the threats posed by humans. It was almost driven to extinction by hunters in the 19th century. Legal protection ensured its survival for a while, and numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century. But the respite was only temporary. In the ten years following the break-up of the former Soviet Union in 1991, over 95% of the global population was lost - one of the fastest examples of species loss ever recorded for a mammal.

            原文片段 · 4The dramatic decline during this decade was due to illegal poaching on an industrial scale. Male saiga are a particular target, because their horns are highly prized by traditional medicine practitioners. Poaching reached epidemic levels after misguided conservationists tried to relieve the pressure on threatened African rhinos by actively encouraging the use of saiga horns in traditional medicine as an alternative to those of rhinos. Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.

            1. has a large bulbous nose with swollen nostrils that keep ______ out

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            2. lower the temperature of its ______ in summer

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            3. grows a thick ______ in winter, which it loses in spring

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            4. poaching, especially for the ______ of male saiga

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            8. Today, numbers of saiga are distributed evenly across four nations in Central Asia: Kazakhstan, Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            9. For most of the 20th century, the population of saiga were falling.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            10. Efforts to protect rhinos in Africa had a significant effect on saiga populations.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 1 题 · dust

            keep out把filter out改述为阻挡进入；原文dust是名词，满足一词。

            they filter out dust

            第 2 题 · blood

            lower the temperature of对应cool；被降温的是blood，不能填空气。

            cool the blood during hot, dry summers

            第 3 题 · coat

            thick对应heavy；loses对应sheds，空格是毛被coat。

            a heavy winter coat that the saiga sheds when the weather warms up

            第 4 题 · horns

            poaching目的与because后的价值原因对应；须保留复数horns。

            Male saiga are a particular target, because their horns are highly prized

            第 8 题 · FALSE

            四国被提到不等于平均分布。超过90%在一国直接反驳evenly。

            Kazakhstan ... well over 90% of the global saiga population

            第 9 题 · FALSE

            时间范围完全对应most of the 20th century，方向却是recovered而非falling。

            numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century

            第 10 题 · TRUE

            保护犀牛的替代用角倡议→雄性赛加几乎被捕尽→种群崩溃；effect不一定是正面效果。

            encouraging the use of saiga horns ... as an alternative to those of rhinos. Male saiga were almost wiped out

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            文章把赛加羚羊适应自然环境的能力与抵御人为威胁的无力并置：鼻腔、季节性毛被能应对草原气候，却无法阻止猎杀。随后追溯数量恢复又崩溃的历史，并解释一项保护犀牛的倡议怎样把捕猎压力转移给了赛加。

            原文片段 · 1

            The saiga, a species of antelope native to Central Asia, once roamed the vast grasslands of this region in enormous herds, many millions strong. Regrettably, such spectacular sights are a thing of the past. Today, the saiga is largely confined to a single country: Kazakhstan. This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.

            先从过去数以百万计的大群迁徙写到文章叙述时数量集中于哈萨克斯坦，形成鲜明反差。native to 说明物种原产地；largely 和 well over 90% 表示高度集中，却不是其余国家已完全没有赛加。this country 指哈萨克斯坦，the rest 指全球种群中剩下的部分。

            原文片段 · 2

            The saiga is perfectly adapted to the tough conditions of the remote wilderness of the steppes of Central Asia. One such adaptation is its bizarre bulbous nose, which enables the animal to survive the extreme seasonal temperature swings of the region. The swollen nostrils of the nose serve several purposes: they filter out dust and cool the blood during hot, dry summers, and they warm the cold air before it enters the saiga's lungs in winter. Other seasonal adaptations include a heavy winter coat that the saiga sheds when the weather warms up.

            大鼻子看起来奇特，却承担实用功能：夏季过滤尘土并为血液降温，冬季预热进入肺部的空气。冬毛则随着天气转暖脱落。两类例子共同说明适应是器官结构与季节变化的配合；extreme seasonal temperature swings 指季节之间很大的温差。

            原文片段 · 3

            Despite these superb adaptations to harsh conditions, the saiga has no defence against the threats posed by humans. It was almost driven to extinction by hunters in the 19th century. Legal protection ensured its survival for a while, and numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century. But the respite was only temporary. In the ten years following the break-up of the former Soviet Union in 1991, over 95% of the global population was lost - one of the fastest examples of species loss ever recorded for a mammal.

            Despite 把话题从自然适应转到人为威胁。19世纪猎杀几乎使它灭绝，法律保护曾带来20世纪大部分时期的恢复；但1991年之后的十年里，全球数量又损失超过95%。respite 是暂时喘息，不意味着危险从此消失。这里的时间与数量属于原文历史叙述。

            原文片段 · 4

            The dramatic decline during this decade was due to illegal poaching on an industrial scale. Male saiga are a particular target, because their horns are highly prized by traditional medicine practitioners. Poaching reached epidemic levels after misguided conservationists tried to relieve the pressure on threatened African rhinos by actively encouraging the use of saiga horns in traditional medicine as an alternative to those of rhinos. Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.

            本段解释上段所说的骤减：偷猎规模极大，雄性因角的市场价值成为主要对象。一些保护者曾鼓励用赛加角替代犀牛角，结果压力转移到另一个物种。misguided 评价的是这种判断失误；雄性几近消失进一步造成种群崩溃，文中没有把善意等同于有效保护。

            词语与搭配

            a thing of the past

            已成为过去的景象或事物

            原文说的是庞大兽群的壮观景象，不是在说赛加这个物种已经灭绝。

            is largely confined to

            主要局限于

            be confined to 后接地区或范围；largely 保留例外，准确表达分布集中。

            on an industrial scale

            以工业化般的巨大规模

            修饰偷猎规模，强调组织化、数量大，并非说偷猎本身属于合法工业。

            relieve the pressure on

            减轻……承受的压力

            原文是减轻犀牛遭捕猎的压力；可接 species、resources 等压力承受对象。

            句子精读

            This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.

            据估计，全球远超90%的赛加羚羊生活在这个国家，其余分布在俄罗斯、蒙古和乌兹别克斯坦。

            This country 回指哈萨克斯坦。is estimated to 表示这是估算；be home to 表示是某物的生活地。with 引出补充情况，accounting for 的主语是后面列出的三国；the rest 是剩余种群。

            Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.

            雄性赛加几乎被捕杀殆尽，造成种群数量暴跌，而这个物种自那以后一直艰难地恢复。

            leading to 表示前面事件带来的结果。from which 中 which 指 a population crash，recover from 表示从打击中恢复。has been struggling 和 ever since 共同突出恢复过程延续到作者叙述时仍未结束。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            on an industrial scale

            以极大的、工业化的规模

            适合描述技术与设备使资源开采规模扩大；不能把所有小型经营都称为 industrial scale。

            用于写作：过度捕捞题讨论捕捞能力与生态压力，大型船舶造成的规模效应与原文大规模猎杀直接相关。

            relieve the pressure on

            减轻……所承受的压力

            说明措施帮助哪个对象；on 后接鱼群、生态系统等，随后解释压力怎样减少。

            用于写作：直接用于过度捕捞的措施段，把休渔与鱼群恢复相连；不套用赛加保护倡议的历史结果。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Saving the saiga · 栖息地、疾病、气候与恢复未作答笔记填空 / 事实判断 TFNG · 5 段 · 451 词 · 6 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 61, 62 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            这里包含原文后半部连续5段。两道NOT GIVEN已同时核对完整原文；不是因为裁切省略了答案。种群数和now按原考试文章时间理解。

            原文片段 · 1Another threat to the survival of the saiga is loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement. Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species. In the worst cases, herds may starve to death after being trapped.

            原文片段 · 2Then there is the risk of disease. In 2015, an outbreak of haemorrhagic septicaemia, caused by the normally harmless bacterium Pasteurella multocida, killed over 75% of the global adult saiga population in just three weeks. In 2017, 60% of the Mongolian saiga population - a subspecies found nowhere else in the world - was killed by a virus that spilled over from livestock. These so-called mass mortality events represent an unpredictable and serious threat to the species.

            原文片段 · 3Climate change poses a further threat. Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate. Experts believe that unusually warm weather may have triggered the 2015 mass mortality event. The steppe region has also become increasingly arid in recent years, and many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished.

            原文片段 · 4Recent efforts to save the saiga have been spearheaded by the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, a project led by the Association for the Conservation of Biodiversity of Kazakhstan, working in partnership with the Kazakh government's Committee for Forestry and Wildlife, Frankfurt Zoological Society and Fauna and Flora, an international conservation charity. Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga. In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project, an accolade reserved for the ten best examples of large-scale ecosystem restoration around the globe.

            原文片段 · 5So, how many saiga are there now? By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all time low of just 21,000 individuals. There was some recovery in the first decade of the new millennium but this was then crushed by devastating mass mortality events that saw the loss of hundreds of thousands of the species. But thanks to the intervention of the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, the most recent episodes in the ongoing story of the saiga have been relatively uplifting. Three years ago, the Ustyurt Plateau population in Kazakhstan experienced its largest mass birth of saiga calves in many years. An aerial census two years ago recorded an estimated 842,000 saiga across Kazakhstan as a whole, and according to an aerial survey earlier this year, the saiga population in Kazakhstan now exceeds 1.9 million. The world's strangest-looking antelope remains critically endangered, but the direction of travel is positive.

            5. expansion of farms and settlements, causing reduction in the size of the saiga's ______

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            6. loss of access to the ______ which they use for migration

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            7. climate change, causing the disappearance of ______ which the saiga relied on

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            11. Unpredictable fluctuations in climate are threatening the wildlife of Central Asia more than in other parts of the world.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            12. The Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative was formed for the benefit of a number of different animals.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            13. The Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative's recognition as a World Restoration Flagship project attracted additional international funding for the scheme.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 5 题 · habitat

            causing与as a result of反向排列同一因果：扩张导致栖息地减少。

            loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement

            第 6 题 · routes

            阻断routes就是loss of access；答案是routes，不是作为障碍的fences。

            Physical barriers ... can block the seasonal migration routes

            第 7 题 · streams

            relied on对应depended on；disappearance对应vanished。

            many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished

            第 11 题 · NOT GIVEN

            文章说明中亚赛加受威胁，但完整原文没有与世界其他地区比较严重程度；more than缺依据。

            saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate

            第 12 题 · TRUE

            many species包括赛加但不限于它，对应a number of different animals。

            protect and restore Kazakhstan's ... ecosystems and the many species they support, including ... saiga

            第 13 题 · NOT GIVEN

            recognition和accolade只说明获得认可；完整原文没有说明因此追加国际资金。

            In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这部分把保护问题扩展到栖息地、跨境迁徙、疾病和气候的相互作用，再介绍生态系统恢复合作及数量回升。结尾同时保留积极趋势与持续风险；now、今年和几年前都以原文写作时点为准。

            原文片段 · 1

            Another threat to the survival of the saiga is loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement. Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species. In the worst cases, herds may starve to death after being trapped.

            农业和定居点扩张挤压栖息地，铁路、管道及围栏又会切断迁徙通道。这里不只是栖息面积减少，还包括原有空间无法连通；受困兽群甚至可能饿死。transboundary 说明赛加活动跨越国界，管理边界与动物活动边界并不重合。

            原文片段 · 2

            Then there is the risk of disease. In 2015, an outbreak of haemorrhagic septicaemia, caused by the normally harmless bacterium Pasteurella multocida, killed over 75% of the global adult saiga population in just three weeks. In 2017, 60% of the Mongolian saiga population - a subspecies found nowhere else in the world - was killed by a virus that spilled over from livestock. These so-called mass mortality events represent an unpredictable and serious threat to the species.

            两次短期大量死亡说明疾病风险的突然性。2015年的病菌平常无害，却引发严重疫情；2017年蒙古亚种又受到从家畜传播来的病毒影响。normally harmless 并不表示永远无害，spilled over 描述病原从一个动物群体传播到另一个群体。

            原文片段 · 3

            Climate change poses a further threat. Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate. Experts believe that unusually warm weather may have triggered the 2015 mass mortality event. The steppe region has also become increasingly arid in recent years, and many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished.

            能适应常见的寒冬与炎夏，不等于能承受所有极端温度和不规则波动。专家把异常暖天气视为2015年大量死亡的可能诱因，may have triggered 保留了推测程度。干旱和溪流消失则构成另一条影响路径，涉及动物可获得的水源。

            原文片段 · 4

            Recent efforts to save the saiga have been spearheaded by the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, a project led by the Association for the Conservation of Biodiversity of Kazakhstan, working in partnership with the Kazakh government's Committee for Forestry and Wildlife, Frankfurt Zoological Society and Fauna and Flora, an international conservation charity. Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga. In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project, an accolade reserved for the ten best examples of large-scale ecosystem restoration around the globe.

            保护行动由 Altyn Dala 项目牵头，并与政府和国际组织合作。目标是修复草原、半沙漠与沙漠生态系统及其中多个物种，赛加只是重点之一。联合国在2022年的认可体现项目受到重视，原文没有把奖项等同于某种新增资源。

            原文片段 · 5

            So, how many saiga are there now? By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all time low of just 21,000 individuals. There was some recovery in the first decade of the new millennium but this was then crushed by devastating mass mortality events that saw the loss of hundreds of thousands of the species. But thanks to the intervention of the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, the most recent episodes in the ongoing story of the saiga have been relatively uplifting. Three years ago, the Ustyurt Plateau population in Kazakhstan experienced its largest mass birth of saiga calves in many years. An aerial census two years ago recorded an estimated 842,000 saiga across Kazakhstan as a whole, and according to an aerial survey earlier this year, the saiga population in Kazakhstan now exceeds 1.9 million. The world's strangest-looking antelope remains critically endangered, but the direction of travel is positive.

            数量变化并非一路上升：2000年降到低点，随后恢复又遭大量死亡打断，之后才出现出生增加和航空调查记录的回升。文末 positive 指发展方向向好，remains 则保留当时仍有严重风险的判断。这里的年份、估算与保护等级都属于原文语境，不能直接当作今天的状态。

            词语与搭配

            loss of habitat

            栖息地丧失

            habitat 指动物赖以生存的环境；与后文迁徙路线被阻断共同描述生存空间的损害。

            spilled over from livestock

            从家畜传播过来

            spill over 在这里比喻病原跨群体传播；livestock 是家畜总称，不是野生动物。

            working in partnership with

            与……协作

            用于说明组织之间共同开展行动；with 后列举合作方。

            the direction of travel is positive

            总体发展方向是积极的

            travel 在这里是趋势比喻，不指赛加的实际迁徙；并不保证以后不会反复。

            句子精读

            Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate.

            赛加虽然很好地适应了寒冷的冬季和炎热的夏季，却难以应对极端温度以及无法预测的气候波动。

            Although 后省略了与主句一致的主语和系动词，可理解为 although they are well adapted。主句 struggle to cope with 强调应对困难；两个并列名词短语分别指极端程度和变化的不稳定性。

            Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga.

            它的目的是保护并修复哈萨克斯坦的草原、半沙漠和沙漠生态系统，以及这些生态系统支持生存的众多物种，其中包括当时处于极危状态的赛加。

            Its 指保护项目。protect and restore 是并列目的动作；they support 修饰 species，they 回指 ecosystems。including 表示赛加包含在多个受益物种之中，而不是项目唯一保护对象。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            working in partnership with

            与……共同合作

            适合说明跨地区生态治理的合作关系，应明确谁和谁合作以及共同处理什么问题。

            用于写作：过度捕捞涉及跨界鱼群，原文跨境物种保护中的机构协作与共享海域监管高度吻合。

            protect and restore

            保护并修复

            protect 强调避免进一步破坏，restore 强调恢复已经受损的状态；并列时应同时存在预防与修复需要。

            用于写作：可用于说明限制捕捞的生态目标，并与题目中的渔业生计相衔接。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Dar es Salaam · 城市扩张与交通方案未作答事实判断 TFNG · 5 段 · 356 词 · 5 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 65 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            保留开篇连续5段。Q14和Q16的NOT GIVEN已对全文核验；并非只凭片段没有出现就判缺信息。

            原文片段 · 1Dar es Salaam in Tanzania is one of the fastest growing cities in Africa. Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 and swells by half a million people every year. United Nations projections anticipate it will become a megacity within seven years as its population passes 10 million, reaching 13.4 million by 2035. Daniel Hoornweg for the Global Cities Institute forecasts the city could be home to an incredible 73.7 million people by 2100.

            原文片段 · 2Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours. It can be longer if rain turns the dirt roads to mud.

            原文片段 · 3Even in the middle of the day, traffic frequently slows to a stop without warning. It is not unusual for cars and minibuses to queue for 20 minutes at a key intersection. A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south but is tiny in the context of the wider city. Outside the centre many rely on boda boda (motorbike taxis) to navigate the narrow side streets and potholed mud roads that make up much of the metropolis. Their safety record is scandalous.

            原文片段 · 4Dar es Salaam's reliance on four arterial roads into the city is a legacy of the colonial government that planned the city at the start of the 20th century to cater for a population of 35,000. Most of the current growth is made up of young people arriving from the countryside to find work, and as the population has exploded, Dar es Salaam has grown around those four highways. Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.

            原文片段 · 5But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car. Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro. It has chosen a less exciting but cheaper and more achievable method: the bus.

            14. The population of Dar es Salaam is rising more rapidly than was previously predicted.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            15. Most of the residents of Dar es Salaam live in high-rise blocks on the edge of the city.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            16. Residents have been consulted about their views on the suburban rail line in Dar es Salaam.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            17. The majority of the present residential development in Dar es Salaam is unplanned.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            18. Dar es Salaam's authorities have decided to follow the public transport plan adopted by a large number of African cities.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 14 题 · NOT GIVEN

            原文给历史增长和多份未来预测，没有“实际超过以前预测”的同一指标比较；不能由多个大数字推出more rapidly。

            Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 ... United Nations projections anticipate ...

            第 15 题 · FALSE

            four out of five支持most，但single-storey直接反驳high-rise。

            four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements

            第 16 题 · NOT GIVEN

            有铁路服务不等于居民接受过意见咨询；全文未述consultation。

            A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south

            第 17 题 · TRUE

            nearly all对应majority；without any agreed strategy对应unplanned。

            nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy

            第 18 题 · FALSE

            Unlike标示相反路径：很多城市地铁，本市公交；不是采用共同方案。

            Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro. ... the bus.

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            文章用人口增长、外围低密度扩张与旧道路格局解释达累斯萨拉姆的出行困境，再引出选择快速公交的背景。人口预测与现实记录分开呈现；公交被认为更便宜、更可实现，并非已经解决全部交通问题。

            原文片段 · 1

            Dar es Salaam in Tanzania is one of the fastest growing cities in Africa. Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 and swells by half a million people every year. United Nations projections anticipate it will become a megacity within seven years as its population passes 10 million, reaching 13.4 million by 2035. Daniel Hoornweg for the Global Cities Institute forecasts the city could be home to an incredible 73.7 million people by 2100.

            人口已经增长八倍是过去到原文当下的变化；未来成为千万人口城市，以及2035年、2100年的规模则是不同来源的预测。anticipate、forecasts 和 could 标出预测性质。开头的作用是让后面的交通需求放在急速扩张的城市规模里理解。

            原文片段 · 2

            Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours. It can be longer if rain turns the dirt roads to mud.

            大部分居民住在不断向外扩展的单层非正规住区，往返中心耗时很长；雨水还会把土路变成泥路。空间距离和道路条件一起影响通勤。informal settlements 描述缺少正规规划等条件的住区，不能简单理解为居民随意居住。

            原文片段 · 3

            Even in the middle of the day, traffic frequently slows to a stop without warning. It is not unusual for cars and minibuses to queue for 20 minutes at a key intersection. A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south but is tiny in the context of the wider city. Outside the centre many rely on boda boda (motorbike taxis) to navigate the narrow side streets and potholed mud roads that make up much of the metropolis. Their safety record is scandalous.

            拥堵并不限于上下班时段，现有铁路覆盖也很有限。摩托车出租能穿过狭窄街道，却伴随很差的安全表现。段落展示居民面对的是速度、覆盖与安全的多重约束，而不仅是有没有某一种交通工具。

            原文片段 · 4

            Dar es Salaam's reliance on four arterial roads into the city is a legacy of the colonial government that planned the city at the start of the 20th century to cater for a population of 35,000. Most of the current growth is made up of young people arriving from the countryside to find work, and as the population has exploded, Dar es Salaam has grown around those four highways. Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.

            四条主干道来自为小得多的人口设计的殖民时期规划。后来大量年轻人进城找工作，城市围绕旧路向边缘扩张，却缺少共同策略。legacy 指过去制度或规划留下的长期影响；旧骨架承受新规模，解释了前面出行问题的结构背景。

            原文片段 · 5

            But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car. Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro. It has chosen a less exciting but cheaper and more achievable method: the bus.

            But 将叙述转向当地希望采用的方案：快速公交可能提供一种不由私家车主导的发展路径。作者把公交与地铁比较，强调成本与可实现性，而不是把技术是否令人兴奋作为首要标准。could offer 保留了方案潜力尚待实现的意味。

            词语与搭配

            informal settlements

            非正规住区

            城市研究中描述未完整纳入正规规划或基础设施体系的居住区域；不要直接等同于所有低收入社区。

            to cater for a population of

            为某一规模的人口提供服务

            cater for 不只表示提供餐饮，这里指规划满足人口需求。

            on the periphery

            在城市边缘

            the periphery 与中心相对，可用于描述城市扩张的空间方向。

            pinning its hopes on

            把希望寄托在……上

            pin one's hopes on 后接计划或方案，带有期待色彩，不能代替对成效的实际证明。

            句子精读

            Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours.

            在作者叙述时，这座城市五分之四的居民住在不断向外扩展的城市边缘的单层非正规住区，从那里往返市中心经常需要两个多小时。

            its 指达累斯萨拉姆。主干是 people live in settlements，single-storey 描述房屋形态，on the spreading edges 补充所在位置。where 回接这些外围地点，说明居民从该处出行的耗时。

            But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car.

            但达累斯萨拉姆正把希望寄托在一个可能为非洲超大城市提供不同发展模式的方案上，让这些城市有机会选择另一条道路，而不是走向由私家车主导的未来。

            that could offer 修饰 solution，could 表示可能性。giving them 补充这种方案可能带来的作用，them 指非洲超大城市。controlled by the private car 修饰 future，private car 泛指以私家车为核心的出行模式。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            on the periphery

            在城市外围

            用于讨论住房位置与服务距离，需要说明外围扩张带来的具体条件，不能据此断定所有郊区住房都不好。

            用于写作：高层住宅题涉及如何在大城市提供足够住房；这一表达帮助比较外围扩张与紧凑建设的出行影响。

            a future controlled by the private car

            由私家车主导的未来

            适合描述城市发展的整体方向，随后应解释公共交通如何提供现实替代。

            用于写作：直接回应交通题鼓励替代交通方式的主张；不自动推出必须统一限制所有地区的汽车拥有量。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Dar es Salaam · 公交设计与实际故障未作答笔记填空 · 4 段 · 316 词 · 8 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 65, 66 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第6–9段连续裁切，包含所有8个填空证据。路线未来阶段按文章当时的计划理解。

            原文片段 · 1The DART bus rapid transit (BRT) system runs on bus lanes separated from other traffic, mostly in the middle of the road to reduce stoppages. Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.

            原文片段 · 2'The new buses are much, much better,' says Paulas George, a young IT worker. He takes the bus every day and it has cut his journey time by two-thirds. He says it is not perfect, though, complaining that drivers often refuse to turn on the air conditioning to save fuel.

            原文片段 · 3That is not the only problem. A shortage of buses after a serious flood at the main depot during the rainy season means the system is carrying 200,000 people a day - half the expected capacity. Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working either, forcing passengers to buy individual paper tickets for every journey. Each is printed with a scannable QR code, but there are no scanners. Staff stand by the gates and tear tickets as people enter. As a result, queues are considerable at peak times.

            原文片段 · 4Morogoro Road to the north-west of the city was phase I of the BRT project. Phases II and III will install bus lanes along Nyerere Road to the south-west and Kilwa Road to the south. Construction on both routes is due to start imminently. Phase IV, towards Bagamoyo in the north, is in the preliminary design stage. 'Much of the city will have access to a world-class transport system within the space of a few years,' says Chris Kost, the Africa director of ITDP (the Institute for Transportation and Development Policy). All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.

            19. the buses use designated ______ to cut down on delays

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            20. passengers pay fares before ______

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            21. passengers in ______ can use every part of the system

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            22. the temperature control is sometimes not activated in order to reduce ______ use

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            23. insufficient number of vehicles are available due to the effects of a severe ______

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            24. passengers are unable to use ______ because some equipment is out of action

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            25. tickets have to be checked manually at station ______

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            26. ______ frequently build up during rush hours

            Complete the notes below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 19 题 · lanes

            designated lanes对应与其他交通隔开的专用道；delays改述stoppages。

            bus lanes separated from other traffic ... to reduce stoppages

            第 20 题 · boarding

            before与prior to同义；答案boarding是付费之后发生的动作。

            Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding

            第 21 题 · wheelchairs

            in wheelchairs改述using wheelchairs；题目限定乘客在什么工具中，不填baby buggies。

            the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs

            第 22 题 · fuel

            temperature control对应air conditioning；reduce ... use对应save，保留名词fuel。

            drivers often refuse to turn on the air conditioning to save fuel

            第 23 题 · flood

            insufficient number对应shortage；severe对应serious；缺车原因是flood。

            A shortage of buses after a serious flood at the main depot

            第 24 题 · smartcards

            some equipment指读卡器，空格问不能使用的东西，因此填smartcards而非readers。

            Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working

            第 25 题 · gates

            人工撕票的地点是gates；tickets在题面已给，不能重复填入。

            Staff stand by the gates and tear tickets as people enter

            第 26 题 · queues

            rush hours与peak times同义；人工检票造成queues，单词复数照原文。

            As a result, queues are considerable at peak times

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这一部分先讲快速公交为什么能提高通行效率与可达性，再用乘客体验和设备故障说明设计与运行的差别，最后交代扩建计划。便利来自专用车道、提前检票和无台阶车辆等具体安排，也依赖车辆、票务和维护正常运作。

            原文片段 · 1

            The DART bus rapid transit (BRT) system runs on bus lanes separated from other traffic, mostly in the middle of the road to reduce stoppages. Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.

            专用车道与其他车辆分隔，减少公交受混合交通阻塞的机会；购票和检票放在上车之前，可以减少登车环节的拖延。无台阶车辆让轮椅使用者及推婴儿车的人更容易使用线路。accessible 在这里是实际能进入和使用，不只是知道线路在哪里。

            原文片段 · 2

            'The new buses are much, much better,' says Paulas George, a young IT worker. He takes the bus every day and it has cut his journey time by two-thirds. He says it is not perfect, though, complaining that drivers often refuse to turn on the air conditioning to save fuel.

            乘客 Paulas 的通勤时间缩短了三分之二，但司机为节油不开空调使体验打了折扣。个人评价同时含有改善和不满，though 承接这种转折。原文描述的是这名乘客的经历，不能将相同降幅推给每一位乘客。

            原文片段 · 3

            That is not the only problem. A shortage of buses after a serious flood at the main depot during the rainy season means the system is carrying 200,000 people a day - half the expected capacity. Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working either, forcing passengers to buy individual paper tickets for every journey. Each is printed with a scannable QR code, but there are no scanners. Staff stand by the gates and tear tickets as people enter. As a result, queues are considerable at peak times.

            洪水损坏车库后的车辆短缺使运量只有预期的一半；读卡器和扫码器问题又迫使乘客每次买纸票、工作人员手撕票。技术功能存在于票面或系统设计中，却未真正发挥作用，因此高峰排队明显。That 回接空调问题，说明后面还有更多运行困难。

            原文片段 · 4

            Morogoro Road to the north-west of the city was phase I of the BRT project. Phases II and III will install bus lanes along Nyerere Road to the south-west and Kilwa Road to the south. Construction on both routes is due to start imminently. Phase IV, towards Bagamoyo in the north, is in the preliminary design stage. 'Much of the city will have access to a world-class transport system within the space of a few years,' says Chris Kost, the Africa director of ITDP (the Institute for Transportation and Development Policy). All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.

            叙述从当前故障转向分期扩建：第一期已有线路，第二、三期即将施工，第四期尚在初步设计。完成后约三分之一居民能步行短距离接入网络，是带条件的未来覆盖描述。不同阶段不能都理解成已经建好并投入使用。

            词语与搭配

            prior to boarding

            在上车之前

            prior to 比 before 稍正式；to 是介词，后接 boarding，说明购票检票发生的顺序。

            accessible to people using wheelchairs

            轮椅使用者能够使用

            be accessible to 指对某群体可进入、可使用；这里有无台阶设计作为具体支撑。

            half the expected capacity

            预期运载能力的一半

            expected 标明比较基准是预期值，不是原有实际客流量。

            within a short walk of

            在步行很短距离即可到达……的范围内

            常用来描述住宅与车站、服务设施的接近程度；原文用于尚待完成的线路网络。

            句子精读

            Ticket purchase and control takes place at stations prior to boarding and the buses are step-free, which means the entire route is accessible to people using wheelchairs or who are travelling with baby buggies.

            购票和检票都在乘客上车前于车站进行，而且公交车没有台阶，这意味着轮椅使用者或推着婴儿车出行的人都能使用整条线路。

            control 在票务语境中是检票。and 连接车站流程与车辆设计，which means 引出无障碍结果。using wheelchairs 和 who are travelling with baby buggies 都修饰 people，分别列出受益人群；引文保留原文形式。

            All phases are being planned to high standards and, once complete, a third of city residents will be within a short walk of the BRT network.

            各期工程都正在按照高标准规划；待工程完成后，全市三分之一的居民步行很短距离就能到达快速公交网络。

            are being planned 表示正在规划。once complete 是省略结构，意思是这些建设完成以后，并不修饰居民。will be 与 once 一起把覆盖率限定为未来完工后的状态。

            Rethinking the Past · 发现怎样改变既有认识未作答选择题 / 句尾匹配 · 3 段 · 285 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 69 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第1–3段连续裁切；第27题的second paragraph仍指原文第2段。句尾匹配保留A–F完整选项，不删干扰项。

            原文片段 · 1It is by now a truism that the story of human evolution is being rethought. Discoveries have come thick and fast over the last decade or so, and these have forced us to rethink many crucial points, such as how old our species is - about 300,000 years old as opposed to 200,000 - and what extinct hominins, such as our cousins the Neanderthals, were really like. But because there are so many species and eras involved, it's hard to discern the common threads linking them.

            原文片段 · 2However, I do think it's possible to draw out some overall messages from the blizzard of archaeological finds in recent years. Two things stand out to me. One is the growing evidence that many supposedly 'advanced' behaviours, such as architecture and art, can be traced much further back in time than we thought, often to hominin species that existed before modern humans. And the other is that we have badly misunderstood gender roles in prehistoric societies, imposing patriarchal values onto cultures that had very different ideas about how women should behave.

            原文片段 · 3Let's start with architecture. At Kalambo Falls in Zambia, researchers found buried logs that had been shaped with stone tools so that they interlocked. They seem to have once been part of a larger structure, perhaps a building. This would be unsurprising if they weren't 476,000 years old. That's almost 200,000 years before our species, Homo sapiens, evolved. Extinct hominins also managed to settle in extreme places. For instance, we now know that extinct hominins such as the Denisovans lived on the frozen heights of high-altitude regions 200,000 years ago - upending the old notion that such environments were only settled by modern humans around 3,600 years ago.

            共用选项 · 原题 31、32

            • D. experts may have been mistaken about who looked for food in early human communities.
            • E. Homo sapiens was probably not the only species capable of sophisticated workmanship.
            • F. other species managed to survive in harsh environments before the arrival of Homo sapiens.

            • B. outlining some aspects of prehistory which are still poorly understood
            • C. summarising some attitudes towards recent archaeological revelations
            • D. giving an overview of some current disagreements among archaeologists

            31. The findings at Kalambo Falls revealed that

            Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A–F, below.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 27 题 · A

            作者归纳两项认识变化，不是在罗列考古学家的争议；second paragraph指原第2段。

            Two things stand out to me. One is ... advanced behaviours ... much further back ... And the other ... misunderstood gender roles

            第 31 题 · E

            石器加工并互锁的木材早于现代人，支撑其他物种也能进行复杂制作；不是说现代人提前出现。

            buried logs ... shaped with stone tools so that they interlocked ... 476,000 years old ... before our species

            第 32 题 · F

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            作者把大量考古发现归纳成两条需要重看的认识：某些被视为先进的行为比过去想象的更早出现，对史前性别分工的看法也可能受当代预设影响。这里主要展开建筑和极端环境定居的例子，注意区分发现本身与研究者对用途的推测。

            原文片段 · 1

            It is by now a truism that the story of human evolution is being rethought. Discoveries have come thick and fast over the last decade or so, and these have forced us to rethink many crucial points, such as how old our species is - about 300,000 years old as opposed to 200,000 - and what extinct hominins, such as our cousins the Neanderthals, were really like. But because there are so many species and eras involved, it's hard to discern the common threads linking them.

            接连出现的发现改变了对人类起源年代及已灭绝人族成员的理解，但物种和年代众多，整体联系并不容易辨认。truism 表示已经被反复承认的说法；common threads 是贯穿材料的共同线索，作者接下来要从碎片发现中提炼这些联系。

            原文片段 · 2

            However, I do think it's possible to draw out some overall messages from the blizzard of archaeological finds in recent years. Two things stand out to me. One is the growing evidence that many supposedly 'advanced' behaviours, such as architecture and art, can be traced much further back in time than we thought, often to hominin species that existed before modern humans. And the other is that we have badly misunderstood gender roles in prehistoric societies, imposing patriarchal values onto cultures that had very different ideas about how women should behave.

            作者明确以 I do think 和 to me 提出自己的归纳：建筑、艺术等行为的历史可能追溯到现代人之前；史前女性角色则被后来的父权观念误读。supposedly 给 advanced 加上距离感，提醒读者所谓先进本身也带有分类与评价。

            原文片段 · 3

            Let's start with architecture. At Kalambo Falls in Zambia, researchers found buried logs that had been shaped with stone tools so that they interlocked. They seem to have once been part of a larger structure, perhaps a building. This would be unsurprising if they weren't 476,000 years old. That's almost 200,000 years before our species, Homo sapiens, evolved. Extinct hominins also managed to settle in extreme places. For instance, we now know that extinct hominins such as the Denisovans lived on the frozen heights of high-altitude regions 200,000 years ago - upending the old notion that such environments were only settled by modern humans around 3,600 years ago.

            赞比亚木构件的加工与咬合显示它们可能属于更大的结构，但 perhaps a building 仍是对用途的推测。476,000年前的年代使发现尤其突出，因为比现代人出现还早。高海拔地区的古人族居住证据则挑战了这类环境很晚才被占据的旧想法。

            词语与搭配

            come thick and fast

            大量而接连不断地出现

            形容发现出现得多且频繁；是较生动的固定表达，不是说发现物本身很厚。

            the common threads

            共同线索

            threads 比喻连接不同发现的主题；作者想理解它们共同改变了什么认识。

            can be traced much further back in time

            可以追溯到久远得多的过去

            be traced back 表示追溯起源；much 修饰比较级 further，强调与旧估计的差距。

            imposing patriarchal values onto cultures

            把父权价值观强加到其他文化的解释上

            这里指用后来研究者的观念解读古代文化，并非说这些研究者真的改变了史前社会。

            句子精读

            One is the growing evidence that many supposedly 'advanced' behaviours, such as architecture and art, can be traced much further back in time than we thought, often to hominin species that existed before modern humans.

            其中一点是，越来越多证据显示，建筑和艺术等许多所谓先进的行为，可以追溯到比我们原先想象久远得多的年代，往往追溯到现代人出现之前就已存在的人族物种。

            One 指作者归纳出的两条认识之一。第一个 that 引出 evidence 的具体内容，such as 插入例子；than we thought 给出比较基准。最后的 that existed 修饰 hominin species，限定这些物种所处的时代。

            At Kalambo Falls in Zambia, researchers found buried logs that had been shaped with stone tools so that they interlocked.

            在赞比亚的卡兰博瀑布，研究人员发现了埋藏的木料，这些木料曾用石器加工，从而能够相互咬合。

            that had been shaped 修饰 logs，过去完成时表示加工早于研究人员发现。so that 引出加工所达到的目的或效果，they 回指木料。句子先报告材料及加工特征，后文才推测它们可能的用途。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Rethinking the Past · 艺术年代、研究争议与脑容量未作答观点判断 YNNG · 2 段 · 292 词 · 6 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 69, 70 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            保留原第4–5段；第5段跨PDF69–70页已按原句接合，不增删论证。NG已核对整篇文章。

            原文片段 · 1Art also seems to have been invented by older hominins. We have had evidence for a long time now that Neanderthals painted on cave walls. Even earlier species, such as Homo erectus, may also have made art, for example by engraving patterns on shells. By far the most contentious claim in this area is that Homo naledi made art. H. naledi lived around 250,000 years ago, making it a contemporary of our species. However, it had quite a small brain, typical of older hominins - and was therefore, according to palaeoanthropological dogma, incapable of complex behaviours. Nevertheless, in the Rising Star cave system in South Africa where the H. naledi remains were found, researchers have found what seem to be etchings - resembling rudimentary artwork- on the cave walls, though these have yet to be firmly dated.

            原文片段 · 2To say these claims about H. naledi are controversial is to understate the situation. Many experts say the evidence presented so far is completely inadequate to support them. The dispute has only been heightened by the way the results were released, in a non-traditional journal that publishes peer reviews publicly alongside the paper. My views on the H. naledi controversy are complicated. I do think more evidence is needed: in particular with regard to the dating of the etchings. At the same time, I think the species' small brains are a distraction. Palaeoanthropologists got fixated on brain size because it was what they could see: if what you have is skeletons, then all you know about brains are their shapes and sizes. But other properties, such as the brain's internal wiring, are surely equally important and may explain how a species like H. naledi might have been capable of complex behaviours, despite their small brains.

            36. It is very rare to find prehistoric artwork carved onto shells.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            37. The methods which the researchers used to examine the Rising Star cave system were rather unconventional.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            38. It is unclear how old the etchings in the Rising Star cave system are.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            39. The means used to publicise the findings from the Rising Star cave system added to the controversy that surrounds them.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            40. The size of H. naledi brains is a key factor in the question of whether these hominins were able to produce art.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 35 题 · NO

            Even earlier直接给出更早物种可能作画的证据，反驳尼安德特人必为最早的倾向判断。

            Even earlier species, such as Homo erectus, may also have made art

            第 36 题 · NOT GIVEN

            原文只举贝壳刻纹这一例子，全文没有very rare的频率判断。

            may also have made art, for example by engraving patterns on shells

            第 37 题 · NOT GIVEN

            non-traditional修饰发表结果的期刊，不是考察洞穴的方法；全文未评价实地研究方法是否反常。

            the way the results were released, in a non-traditional journal

            第 38 题 · YES

            have yet to be firmly dated表示尚未可靠定年，正好支持unclear how old。

            these have yet to be firmly dated ... more evidence is needed ... dating of the etchings

            第 39 题 · YES

            publicise findings对应results released；added to controversy对应dispute heightened。

            The dispute has only been heightened by the way the results were released

            第 40 题 · NO

            该题问作者观点，不是前人dogma。作者明确把小脑容量称为干扰焦点，不能把先引述的旧教条当作者结论。

            I think the species' small brains are a distraction ... internal wiring ... equally important

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            作者讨论早期人族艺术的证据及 Homo naledi 争议，既要求刻痕年代得到更可靠确认，也反对只凭脑容量判断复杂行为能力。核心张力是证据需要加强，但评估证据的既有框架本身也值得反思。

            原文片段 · 1

            Art also seems to have been invented by older hominins. We have had evidence for a long time now that Neanderthals painted on cave walls. Even earlier species, such as Homo erectus, may also have made art, for example by engraving patterns on shells. By far the most contentious claim in this area is that Homo naledi made art. H. naledi lived around 250,000 years ago, making it a contemporary of our species. However, it had quite a small brain, typical of older hominins - and was therefore, according to palaeoanthropological dogma, incapable of complex behaviours. Nevertheless, in the Rising Star cave system in South Africa where the H. naledi remains were found, researchers have found what seem to be etchings - resembling rudimentary artwork- on the cave walls, though these have yet to be firmly dated.

            对不同物种的证据强度并不相同：尼安德特人壁画已有证据，更早物种制作艺术则以 may 表示可能。关于 Homo naledi 的说法争议最大，因为传统观点把小脑容量与无法进行复杂行为联系起来；洞壁刻痕看似艺术，但仍没有确定年代。contemporary 指与现代人这一物种在时间上并存。

            原文片段 · 2

            To say these claims about H. naledi are controversial is to understate the situation. Many experts say the evidence presented so far is completely inadequate to support them. The dispute has only been heightened by the way the results were released, in a non-traditional journal that publishes peer reviews publicly alongside the paper. My views on the H. naledi controversy are complicated. I do think more evidence is needed: in particular with regard to the dating of the etchings. At the same time, I think the species' small brains are a distraction. Palaeoanthropologists got fixated on brain size because it was what they could see: if what you have is skeletons, then all you know about brains are their shapes and sizes. But other properties, such as the brain's internal wiring, are surely equally important and may explain how a species like H. naledi might have been capable of complex behaviours, despite their small brains.

            争论既涉及证据是否足够，也受到公开同行评议这一发表方式的影响。作者承认需要更强的年代证据，却认为脑容量争论容易分散注意力：骨骼让研究者容易看到形状和大小，内部连接等重要特征反而难以直接得知。最后提出可能解释，没有宣告已经证实 Homo naledi 会创作艺术。

            词语与搭配

            have yet to be firmly dated

            尚未得到可靠断代

            have yet to 表示某事截至叙述时尚未完成；dated 在考古语境中指确定年代。

            the evidence presented so far

            迄今提出的证据

            so far 将判断限定在目前可获得的材料，保留以后出现新证据的可能。

            with regard to

            关于，就……而言

            原文把需要更多证据的范围收窄到刻痕年代，而不是笼统否定全部发现。

            got fixated on brain size

            过于执着于脑容量

            fixated on 带有注意力被单一因素占据的意味，是作者对研究倾向的批评。

            句子精读

            Palaeoanthropologists got fixated on brain size because it was what they could see: if what you have is skeletons, then all you know about brains are their shapes and sizes.

            古人类学家过于执着于脑容量，因为这是他们能观察到的东西：如果手头只有骨骼，那么对大脑所能知道的也就只有形状和大小。

            because 解释注意力集中于脑容量的原因。冒号后用 if 条件句展开限制；what you have 作主语，all you know about brains 表示所知的全部内容。这里说的是材料可见性如何影响研究视角。

            But other properties, such as the brain's internal wiring, are surely equally important and may explain how a species like H. naledi might have been capable of complex behaviours, despite their small brains.

            但其他特征，例如大脑内部的连接方式，想必也同样重要，并且可能解释像 Homo naledi 这样的物种为何虽脑容量较小，却仍可能具备复杂行为能力。

            such as 插入具体特征，how 从句作 explain 的宾语。may explain 与 might have been 都保留可能性；despite 引出小脑容量这一看似相反的条件。surely 显示作者的判断语气，不把后面的推测变成定论。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Rethinking the Past · 渐进变化与性别预设未作答选择题 / 句尾匹配 · 4 段 · 365 词 · 5 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 70 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第6–9段连续裁切；题面sixth/seventh/final paragraph分别对应本片段第1/2/4段。匹配题完整保留A–F。

            原文片段 · 1In a sense, we shouldn't be surprised that so many of these behaviours had their origins in older, extinct hominins. Evolution usually works by incremental steps and so does technology. The first birds weren't great at flying, and the first mobile phones weren't great at, well, anything really. The idea that there was a sudden explosion of intelligence and creativity at some point in our evolution isn't inherently ridiculous: sometimes a system hits a tipping point and undergoes runaway change. But there was never that much evidence that human evolution worked this way. Instead, it seems the Neanderthals and many others all walked so we could run.

            原文片段 · 2One way or another, the H. naledi story is going to be an example of letting our preconceptions get in the way of the evidence. The same is true for our ideas about gender in prehistory. Archaeology was invented by individuals with now unfashionably patriarchal views about gender, and those notions fed into their research. Today's researchers are trying to unpick this stuff, and there have been some significant steps in recent years.

            原文片段 · 3Perhaps the most dramatic was the demolition of 'Man the Hunter'. This was the idea, promoted for decades, that in most prehistoric societies the men went out to hunt and the women looked after the home. However, a meta-analysis published in June 2023 compiled data on several dozen foraging societies and found women hunted in 80 per cent of them. In line with this, it emerged that an ancient spear-throwing tool called an atlatl enables women to launch projectiles at the same speed as men. We have also seen growing evidence of women occupying positions of authority in ancient societies. The Viking queen Thyra may have helped unify Denmark in the 900s. Going further back, an Iberian leader from around 4000 years ago turned out to be female, not male as many had assumed, when proteins in her teeth were analysed.

            原文片段 · 4It seems that the more we find out about past societies, the more our preconceptions about the ways society 'has to be' turn out to be wrong. Inequality, authoritarianism and patriarchy aren't inevitable. They're choices, and prehistory shows us that we can choose differently.

            • D. experts may have been mistaken about who looked for food in early human communities.
            • E. Homo sapiens was probably not the only species capable of sophisticated workmanship.
            • F. other species managed to survive in harsh environments before the arrival of Homo sapiens.
