            第 30 题 · A

            考察史前社会揭示当代制度并非必然，支持我们选择更公平社会。作者不是仅说仍有未知。

            Inequality, authoritarianism and patriarchy aren't inevitable. They're choices, and prehistory shows us that we can choose differently.

            第 33 题 · D

            新汇总反驳男性负责狩猎的旧假定；D谁找食物，B谁掌权不能互换。

            a meta-analysis published in June 2023 ... found women hunted in 80 per cent of them

            第 34 题 · B

            牙齿蛋白分析推翻领导者为男性的假设，对应谁有权力的旧看法不准确。

            an Iberian leader ... turned out to be female, not male as many had assumed

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            作者从渐进演化谈到研究预设，再用女性狩猎和担任领导者的材料质疑单一的史前性别分工故事。结尾由历史认识上升到对社会选择的评论，这是作者的论述立场，不应把它当作所有史前社会相同的证明。

            原文片段 · 1

            In a sense, we shouldn't be surprised that so many of these behaviours had their origins in older, extinct hominins. Evolution usually works by incremental steps and so does technology. The first birds weren't great at flying, and the first mobile phones weren't great at, well, anything really. The idea that there was a sudden explosion of intelligence and creativity at some point in our evolution isn't inherently ridiculous: sometimes a system hits a tipping point and undergoes runaway change. But there was never that much evidence that human evolution worked this way. Instead, it seems the Neanderthals and many others all walked so we could run.

            鸟类飞行与早期手机的类比说明复杂能力往往逐步积累。作者承认系统可能达到临界点后迅速变化，但认为人类演化突然发生智力爆发的证据并不充分。walked so we could run 是比喻：早期人族积累的能力为后来发展铺路，不是字面上的走路与跑步史。

            原文片段 · 2

            One way or another, the H. naledi story is going to be an example of letting our preconceptions get in the way of the evidence. The same is true for our ideas about gender in prehistory. Archaeology was invented by individuals with now unfashionably patriarchal views about gender, and those notions fed into their research. Today's researchers are trying to unpick this stuff, and there have been some significant steps in recent years.

            不论 Homo naledi 的争议最后如何解决，作者都认为这反映预设可能妨碍理解证据。随后把同一问题转到性别研究：早期考古学家的父权观念进入研究解释，如今的研究者尝试把这些观念从材料中拆解出来。those notions 回指前面的性别观念。

            原文片段 · 3

            Perhaps the most dramatic was the demolition of 'Man the Hunter'. This was the idea, promoted for decades, that in most prehistoric societies the men went out to hunt and the women looked after the home. However, a meta-analysis published in June 2023 compiled data on several dozen foraging societies and found women hunted in 80 per cent of them. In line with this, it emerged that an ancient spear-throwing tool called an atlatl enables women to launch projectiles at the same speed as men. We have also seen growing evidence of women occupying positions of authority in ancient societies. The Viking queen Thyra may have helped unify Denmark in the 900s. Going further back, an Iberian leader from around 4000 years ago turned out to be female, not male as many had assumed, when proteins in her teeth were analysed.

            多个例子从不同方向松动男性狩猎、女性留家的单一故事：对数十个采集狩猎社会的汇总发现多数有女性狩猎，投矛工具可缩小投射速度差别，古代女性领导者也有新的证据。80%是这份分析涉及的社会比例，不能扩展为所有史前社会；Thyra 的作用仍以 may 表示可能。

            原文片段 · 4

            It seems that the more we find out about past societies, the more our preconceptions about the ways society 'has to be' turn out to be wrong. Inequality, authoritarianism and patriarchy aren't inevitable. They're choices, and prehistory shows us that we can choose differently.

            作者认为，越了解过去，就越能看到今天视为理所当然的社会安排并非唯一可能。把不平等、威权和父权称为 choices 是结尾的价值判断，作用是拓展读者对社会的想象，而不是声称过去所有社会都平等或自由。

            词语与搭配

            incremental steps

            逐步累积的小幅变化

            incremental 强调累积过程；与突然的爆发式变化形成对照。

            hits a tipping point

            达到临界点

            比喻系统发生转折的阈值，文中承认这种机制可能存在，却未断言人类演化必然如此。

            get in the way of the evidence

            妨碍正确看待证据

            get in the way of 表示阻碍；主语是 preconceptions，指先入为主的观念影响解释。

            occupying positions of authority

            担任有权威的职位

            指在社会中拥有领导或决策地位，比简单说某个人受到尊敬更具体。

            句子精读

            The idea that there was a sudden explosion of intelligence and creativity at some point in our evolution isn't inherently ridiculous: sometimes a system hits a tipping point and undergoes runaway change.

            认为人类演化过程中某个时点曾突然出现智力与创造力的爆发，这种想法本身并不荒谬：有时系统确实会达到临界点，并经历迅速扩大的变化。

            that 从句说明 idea 的具体内容。isn't inherently ridiculous 是有限度的认可，并不等于作者接受这个历史解释。冒号后的系统变化说明其理论上可想象；后文再转向实际证据不足。

            Going further back, an Iberian leader from around 4000 years ago turned out to be female, not male as many had assumed, when proteins in her teeth were analysed.

            再往更早的年代看，约四千年前的一位伊比利亚领导者，在牙齿中的蛋白质被分析后，被发现是女性，而非许多人此前以为的男性。

            Going further back 提示叙述时间继续向前追溯。turned out to be 表示后来查明的事实；as many had assumed 插入先前的认识。when 从句交代认识改变所依赖的分析情境，her 回指这位领导者。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Water hyacinth · 入侵植物与能源问题未作答事实判断 TFNG · 4 段 · 407 词 · 7 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 82 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            开篇连续4段保留完整因果背景；两道NG另核对了全文，没有把片段未出现的内容当答案。健康数值只作为原考试文章陈述理解。

            原文片段 · 1Water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes), an aquatic plant native to South America, first appeared in countries in Africa in the early 1900s. Scientists there called it the 'world's worst aquatic weed', after it spread from the southernmost tip of Africa in the early 1900s and started obstructing major dams and rivers.

            原文片段 · 2In east Africa the plant arrived with Belgian colonists in Rwanda, who liked the look of its glossy leaves and delicate purple flowers floating in their ponds. But by the 1980s, it had 'escaped' out of the country via the Kagera river and made its way downstream to Lake Victoria. There, with no natural predators and perfect temperature conditions, the plant began spreading in the open water, blocking fishing routes and providing a new habitat for disease-carrying mosquitoes.

            原文片段 · 3For the women who smoke fish from the lake to sell it has meant declining income, as the boats that once brought the fish to shore by the hundreds struggle to navigate through the mass of plants. But water hyacinth isn't their only headache. In order to smoke the fish that they buy, they must gather huge quantities of firewood, sometimes walking as far as 10km each way to collect enough to complete their work. And each day as they cook, they breathe in the thick, grey smoke. About three out of four families in Kenya depend on wood or charcoal to cook their daily meals, and the rate is even higher in rural areas, Kenya's latest demographic and health survey shows. Using solid fuels like these for cooking increases indoor pollution. The World Health Organization estimates that about 14,300 Kenyans die annually as a result of indoor air pollution - most of which is caused by cooking and heating sources.

            原文片段 · 4Some years ago, on the shores of Lake Victoria, huge piles of water hyacinth that villagers had taken out of the water in an attempt to clear it were a common sight. But buried in those decaying waxy leaves was a renewable energy gold mine. It turns out the floating plant isn't just good at spreading - its foliage also contains a high ratio of carbon to nitrogen. It's a magic combination that has captivated researchers' imaginations since as early as the 1980s when, across the world, they began to explore its potential as a biofuel. Just about 4kg of the dried plant would be enough to cater for a large family's daily energy needs, early research predicted.

            1. Water hyacinth was introduced as a decorative plant in east Africa.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            2. Fishermen took some water hyacinth plants to Lake Victoria.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            3. It is now difficult to force boats through the thick water hyacinth on Lake Victoria.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            4. Chemicals produced by the water hyacinth plants are affecting the numbers of fish in Lake Victoria.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            5. Cooking with charcoal has been proved to be even worse for people's health than cooking with wood.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            6. People found it impossible to remove much water hyacinth from Lake Victoria.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            7. Scientists started investigating the possibility of using water hyacinth to generate biogas in the last century.

            Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 1 题 · TRUE

            liked the look与自家池塘花叶说明最初作装饰用途。

            Belgian colonists in Rwanda, who liked the look of its glossy leaves and delicate purple flowers floating in their ponds

            第 2 题 · FALSE

            实际传播路径是河流顺流而下，不是渔民运送。

            it had 'escaped' out of the country via the Kagera river and made its way downstream to Lake Victoria

            第 3 题 · TRUE

            struggle to navigate对应difficult to force boats through。

            the boats ... struggle to navigate through the mass of plants

            第 4 题 · NOT GIVEN

            文中说堵住捕鱼线路并供蚊子栖息，没有说植物产生化学物质影响鱼数；渔获难运不等于鱼类减少。

            blocking fishing routes and providing a new habitat for disease-carrying mosquitoes

            第 5 题 · NOT GIVEN

            原文并列木材与木炭作为有害固体燃料，但全文没有健康危害高低比较。

            About three out of four families in Kenya depend on wood or charcoal ... Using solid fuels like these ... increases indoor pollution

            第 6 题 · FALSE

            huge piles与taken out说明已移除大量植物，直接反驳impossible to remove much。

            huge piles of water hyacinth that villagers had taken out of the water ... were a common sight

            第 7 题 · TRUE

            1980s属于20世纪；题面last century对应原文年代，不要求你查当今研究。

            since as early as the 1980s ... began to explore its potential as a biofuel

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            文章从水葫芦的入侵路径写到渔业收入、做饭燃料和室内烟尘，再把同一种植物转看为潜在能源。两类问题由湖边家庭的生活相连，结尾的能源价值仍是研究和预测所提出的潜力。

            原文片段 · 1

            Water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes), an aquatic plant native to South America, first appeared in countries in Africa in the early 1900s. Scientists there called it the 'world's worst aquatic weed', after it spread from the southernmost tip of Africa in the early 1900s and started obstructing major dams and rivers.

            水葫芦原产南美，20世纪初进入非洲并开始堵塞重要水坝和河道。aquatic 表示水生；weed 在这里体现它在当地环境中的妨碍作用。最糟糕的水生杂草是文中科学家的称呼，具有评价色彩。

            原文片段 · 2

            In east Africa the plant arrived with Belgian colonists in Rwanda, who liked the look of its glossy leaves and delicate purple flowers floating in their ponds. But by the 1980s, it had 'escaped' out of the country via the Kagera river and made its way downstream to Lake Victoria. There, with no natural predators and perfect temperature conditions, the plant began spreading in the open water, blocking fishing routes and providing a new habitat for disease-carrying mosquitoes.

            它最初作为观赏植物进入卢旺达池塘，随后顺河进入维多利亚湖。缺少天敌且温度适宜，使其迅速扩散：既阻碍捕鱼路线，也为携病蚊虫提供栖息地。escaped 带引号，把植物离开受控种植环境写成逃出。

            原文片段 · 3

            For the women who smoke fish from the lake to sell it has meant declining income, as the boats that once brought the fish to shore by the hundreds struggle to navigate through the mass of plants. But water hyacinth isn't their only headache. In order to smoke the fish that they buy, they must gather huge quantities of firewood, sometimes walking as far as 10km each way to collect enough to complete their work. And each day as they cook, they breathe in the thick, grey smoke. About three out of four families in Kenya depend on wood or charcoal to cook their daily meals, and the rate is even higher in rural areas, Kenya's latest demographic and health survey shows. Using solid fuels like these for cooking increases indoor pollution. The World Health Organization estimates that about 14,300 Kenyans die annually as a result of indoor air pollution - most of which is caused by cooking and heating sources.

            水面被覆盖后，运鱼困难影响熏鱼女性的收入；同时，她们仍需远行拾柴，并长期吸入烹饪烟尘。段落把局部职业处境扩展到许多肯尼亚家庭依赖固体燃料的背景，再引述原文当时的健康估计。室内污染并不都来自烹饪，most of which 保留了这一范围。

            原文片段 · 4

            Some years ago, on the shores of Lake Victoria, huge piles of water hyacinth that villagers had taken out of the water in an attempt to clear it were a common sight. But buried in those decaying waxy leaves was a renewable energy gold mine. It turns out the floating plant isn't just good at spreading - its foliage also contains a high ratio of carbon to nitrogen. It's a magic combination that has captivated researchers' imaginations since as early as the 1980s when, across the world, they began to explore its potential as a biofuel. Just about 4kg of the dried plant would be enough to cater for a large family's daily energy needs, early research predicted.

            被捞上岸的腐烂植物原本像废物，作者却用 gold mine 比喻其中潜藏的能源价值。研究者注意到其碳氮比例并探索生物燃料用途；每天约4公斤干植物可满足大家庭能源需求，是早期研究的预测，不等于所有实际装置已实现同样产出。

            词语与搭配

            made its way downstream

            沿河向下游扩散

            make one's way 描述移动过程；这里主语是植物，指它随着水路进入新的环境。

            disease-carrying mosquitoes

            携带病原、可能传播疾病的蚊虫

            复合形容词说明蚊虫的健康风险，不表示植物本身造成所有相关疾病。

            a renewable energy gold mine

            可再生能源的潜在宝库

            gold mine 是价值比喻，强调废弃植物可能具有用途，并非实际金矿。

            explore its potential as a biofuel

            探索它作为生物燃料的潜力

            explore 和 potential 都说明处于研究与评估阶段，不能改述成效果已经被全面证实。

            句子精读

            There, with no natural predators and perfect temperature conditions, the plant began spreading in the open water, blocking fishing routes and providing a new habitat for disease-carrying mosquitoes.

            在那里，由于没有天敌且温度条件十分适宜，这种植物开始在开放水域扩散，堵住捕鱼路线，并为携病蚊虫提供了新的栖息地。

            There 指维多利亚湖。with 短语交代促成扩散的条件；主干是 the plant began spreading。blocking 与 providing 并列补充扩散伴随的两个后果，分别涉及生计和健康。

            But buried in those decaying waxy leaves was a renewable energy gold mine.

            然而，那些正在腐烂的蜡质叶片里，却藏着一座可再生能源宝库。

            这是把 buried in those decaying waxy leaves 提到句首的倒装表达，主语 a renewable energy gold mine 放在 was 后面。But 改变观察角度：同一堆植物从需清除的麻烦转成可能利用的资源。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Water hyacinth · 沼气流程、收益与价格障碍未作答流程图填空 / 笔记填空 · 5 段 · 345 词 · 6 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 83 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第6–10段连续裁切。原流程最后一步为“Then use the gas for cooking as well as making water fit for human consumption”，与片段purifying water对应，未另造步骤。

            原文片段 · 1In 2018, the technology came to a village on the shore of Lake Victoria, called Dunga. The project promised a two-for-one solution to the dual menaces of the water hyacinth and dependence on firewood. The community received a pair of donated biogas digesters - machines that would transform a mix of water hyacinth and cow dung into biogas for cooking.

            原文片段 · 2The digesters work a bit like a stomach. The mixture goes in one end - think of it as a mouth - and over the next 20 to 30 days, it goes through a fermentation process and breaks down, giving off gas that comes out the other end. From there, the clean burning gas is passed through pipes to the point of use, just like traditional domestic gas. In Dunga, the machines produce enough gas to serve about 60% of the village's population. It is used in domestic stoves and for other household tasks such as purifying water and incubating chicks.

            原文片段 · 3The project is testing whether biogas can provide an effective alternative to firewood and charcoal in rural Kenyan communities. Results indicate that the programme seems to be working. The women who smoke the lake fish are already getting sick less often. Besides, they don't have to devote a lot of time every day to gathering firewood, which is a great relief. As a result, they're able to make more money for their families from other enterprises.

            原文片段 · 4Kanyiva Muindi is an epidemiologist and air pollution research fellow at the African Population and Health Research Centre in Nairobi. She says families who switch to the smokeless cooking method could expect fewer respiratory diseases. Women, young girls and children are particularly vulnerable because they are the ones who cook in the kitchen or outside over fires.

            原文片段 · 5How much better the biogas stoves will be for the community's health still needs more research, says Dominic Kahumbu Wanjihia, Biogas International's chief executive. But unless the price of the machines drops, it's pretty clear that most communities will never be able to afford any, since they sell for about $750.

            第 8 题 · cow dung

            本村digester混入cow dung，两词；不能因前文另有chicken manure实验就换材料。

            a mix of water hyacinth and cow dung into biogas for cooking

            第 9 题 · fermentation / fermentation process

            题面until ... completed对应经过发酵阶段；官方答案接受fermentation或fermentation process，均不超过两词。

            填运送管道pipes，不填终点homes或燃气本身。流程终点还包括做饭和净水。

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            Dunga 的项目把水葫芦和牛粪转成沼气，同时尝试减少水生植物危害与柴火依赖。文章交代运作过程和初步生活变化，也保留健康效果仍需研究、设备成本阻碍推广两项限制。

            原文片段 · 1

            In 2018, the technology came to a village on the shore of Lake Victoria, called Dunga. The project promised a two-for-one solution to the dual menaces of the water hyacinth and dependence on firewood. The community received a pair of donated biogas digesters - machines that would transform a mix of water hyacinth and cow dung into biogas for cooking.

            2018年，当地收到两台捐赠的沼气消化装置，原料是水葫芦与牛粪的混合物。two-for-one 指一项方案同时面对两个问题：植物堵水与燃料依赖。promised 表示项目提出的承诺或前景，不代表每一方面成效已完全实现。

            原文片段 · 2

            The digesters work a bit like a stomach. The mixture goes in one end - think of it as a mouth - and over the next 20 to 30 days, it goes through a fermentation process and breaks down, giving off gas that comes out the other end. From there, the clean burning gas is passed through pipes to the point of use, just like traditional domestic gas. In Dunga, the machines produce enough gas to serve about 60% of the village's population. It is used in domestic stoves and for other household tasks such as purifying water and incubating chicks.

            胃和嘴的比喻帮助理解装置：混合物进入后，在20至30天里发酵分解，释放的气体经管道送往使用处。原文说供应量可覆盖村庄约60%人口，并举出做饭、净水及孵小鸡用途。It 在末句指沼气，而非消化装置本体。

            原文片段 · 3

            The project is testing whether biogas can provide an effective alternative to firewood and charcoal in rural Kenyan communities. Results indicate that the programme seems to be working. The women who smoke the lake fish are already getting sick less often. Besides, they don't have to devote a lot of time every day to gathering firewood, which is a great relief. As a result, they're able to make more money for their families from other enterprises.

            作者描述初步变化：熏鱼女性生病次数减少，也节省了每天拾柴的时间，从而有机会经营其他生计。seems to be working 保留观察的初步性。经济收益不只是买燃料花费改变，还包括时间被释放后可以投入其他活动。

            原文片段 · 4

            Kanyiva Muindi is an epidemiologist and air pollution research fellow at the African Population and Health Research Centre in Nairobi. She says families who switch to the smokeless cooking method could expect fewer respiratory diseases. Women, young girls and children are particularly vulnerable because they are the ones who cook in the kitchen or outside over fires.

            研究人员认为，改用无烟烹饪的家庭有望减少呼吸系统疾病；妇女、女孩和儿童因经常在炉火旁做饭而更易受影响。because 把脆弱性与接触环境相连，并非声称这些群体生理上必然更弱。could expect 是预期而非效果保证。

            原文片段 · 5

            How much better the biogas stoves will be for the community's health still needs more research, says Dominic Kahumbu Wanjihia, Biogas International's chief executive. But unless the price of the machines drops, it's pretty clear that most communities will never be able to afford any, since they sell for about $750.

            文章最后主动收紧结论：社区健康改善究竟多大还需更多研究。与此同时，约750美元的售价使多数社区难以负担，除非价格下降。技术能工作、能改善生活与能被广泛购买，是三个不同的问题；捐赠试点不自动证明商业推广可行。

            词语与搭配

            a two-for-one solution

            同时解决两个问题的方案

            two-for-one 借用日常促销表达，这里指一种技术有两个预期用途，不是实际购买折扣。

            goes through a fermentation process

            经历发酵过程

            go through 表示经历某过程；这里的主语是进入装置的混合原料。

            provide an effective alternative to

            为……提供有效替代

            alternative to 后接被替代的方式；effective 需要具体效果支持，不能仅表示更新颖。

            devote a lot of time every day to gathering firewood

            每天花大量时间收集柴火

            devote time to 后用名词或动名词，to gathering 中的 to 是介词。

            句子精读

            The mixture goes in one end - think of it as a mouth - and over the next 20 to 30 days, it goes through a fermentation process and breaks down, giving off gas that comes out the other end.

            混合物从一端进入——可以把这一端想成嘴——随后在20至30天里经历发酵并分解，释放出的气体从另一端排出。

            破折号中的话是帮助理解的插入比喻。前一个 it 指入口，后一个 it 指 mixture；要依据各自语境区分。giving off 表示分解时释放气体，that comes out 修饰 gas，交代气体的流向。

            But unless the price of the machines drops, it's pretty clear that most communities will never be able to afford any, since they sell for about $750.

            但除非这些机器降价，否则很明显，多数社区将无力购买，因为它们的售价约为750美元。

            unless 表示只有价格下降才可能改变后面的负担问题。any 省略了 machines，they 也回指设备。since 在这里解释原因而非表示自某时以来；never 带出受访者对当前价格障碍的强烈判断。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Multilingualism · 迁移背景与研究目标未作答摘要填空 / 观点判断 YNNG · 4 段 · 395 词 · 9 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 86 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第1–4段连续裁切；词表A–J保留原题所有选项，含OCR漏掉的I已按原选项和答案页恢复。NG21已核对完整文章。

            原文片段 · 1The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life. Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives. Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life. Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.

            原文片段 · 2A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar. The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.

            原文片段 · 3'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli. She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school - a problem disproportionately affecting female students.

            原文片段 · 4Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home. The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas. Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas. They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

            共用选项 · 原题 14、15、16、17、18、19

            • A. basic outlook
            • B. employment opportunities
            • C. wealthy visitors
            • D. distant country
            • E. primary objective
            • F. similar advantages
            • G. thriving economy
            • H. nearby district
            • I. dense population
            • J. new immigrants

            14. The city of Delhi has a ______ and as you walk through its streets you hear people speaking a variety of languages.

            Complete the summary using the list of words below. Write the correct letter for each answer.

            15. Some of them have spent their entire life in Delhi, while others are ______.

            Complete the summary using the list of words below. Write the correct letter for each answer.

            16. Whether they have come from a ______ or have travelled from the other side of India,

            Complete the summary using the list of words below. Write the correct letter for each answer.

            17. they have all come in search of things such as improved ______.

            Complete the summary using the list of words below. Write the correct letter for each answer.

            18. The ______ of the research is to discover why multilingual Indian schoolchildren do not experience

            Complete the summary using the list of words below. Write the correct letter for each answer.

            19. ______ to those that multilingual schoolchildren in Europe experience.

            Complete the summary using the list of words below. Write the correct letter for each answer.

            20. Ten-year-old Indian schoolchildren tend to perform better in literacy tests than in numeracy tests.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            21. Tsimpli had problems convincing some female students to take part in the study.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            22. Tsimpli and her team wanted to know if there is a connection between poor academic performance and being taught in an unfamiliar language.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 14 题 · I

            crowded与2000多万人对应dense population；不是只因bustling就选thriving economy。

            The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life ... more than 20 million people

            第 15 题 · J

            recently迁入与new immigrants对应；不等于wealthy visitors短期游客。

            many millions more have recently made India’s capital their home, having moved from ...

            第 16 题 · H

            surrounding neighbourhoods对应nearby district，与other side形成近/远对照；原文不是移自国外。

            having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country

            第 17 题 · B

            better jobs对应employment opportunities；不要凭“更好生活”添富游客身份。

            often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life

            第 18 题 · E

            overriding aim同义于primary objective，句法也需要单数研究目标。

            The overriding aim of the four-year project ... is to find out why

            第 19 题 · F

            benefits对应advantages；研究问为何并未获得相似收益。

            the many benefits ... observed in schools in Europe ... do not apply to many of India’s schoolchildren

            第 20 题 · NO

            识字不达标超过50%，计算不达标略低于50%，方向与better in literacy相反；比较的是不能完成的比例。

            over 50% ... cannot read ... and just under 50% ... cannot solve ... subtraction

            第 21 题 · NOT GIVEN

            女生受退学影响更多不是难以说服参加研究；全文没有recruitment问题。

            low educational achievement ... dropping out of school ... disproportionately affecting female students

            第 22 题 · YES

            研究的问题正是低学习表现与教学/家庭语言不一致是否有关。

            investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by ... language ... taught in often differs from ... used at home

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            德里的语言多样性来自长期居住与人口迁移。研究关注一个表面矛盾：社会中多语现象普遍，一些学生却没有呈现其他教育环境里观察到的益处。文章把调查问题落到家庭语言、学校授课语言、贫困与学习环境之间的关系，而未先判定多语本身有害。

            原文片段 · 1

            The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life. Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives. Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life. Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.

            繁忙街道的声音引出多语言共存，迁入者常怀着更好工作和生活的希望来到首都。有人熟练使用占主导地位的印地语，也有人主要使用其他官方或地区语言。let alone 强调官方语言数量之外还有更多地区语言；统计值与人口描述沿用原文时点。

            原文片段 · 2

            A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar. The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.

            研究团队对千名小学年龄儿童收集资料，目标不是证明会多种语言一定有益或有害，而是理解为何在某些欧洲学校观察到的益处没有出现在许多印度学生身上。observed in schools in Europe 限定比较经验的来源，不能把它扩大为所有欧洲儿童的普遍结论。

            原文片段 · 3

            'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli. She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school - a problem disproportionately affecting female students.

            研究者引述重复出现的低学习表现：许多五年级儿童仍难以完成二年级阅读和减法任务。这里的比较体现学习进展不足，后果可能是辍学，且女生受到不成比例的影响。can lead to 是风险关系，不是说每个表现偏低的儿童都会离校。

            原文片段 · 4

            Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home. The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas. Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas. They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

            研究进一步检查学校授课语言与家庭语言不同是否可能影响学习，同时记录城乡、住区和迁移背景。家庭贫困限制居住选择，迁移又可能造成儿童原有语言与迁入地语言不同。whether 和 could be caused 表示研究中的问题，不能直接改成已经确定的唯一原因。

            词语与搭配

            in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life

            怀着获得更好工作与生活的希望

            in the hope of 后接动名词，表达迁移者的动机，不表示愿望必然实现。

            The overriding aim

            最主要的目标

            overriding 强调优先地位；原文用来概括项目需要回答的核心问题。

            low educational achievement

            较低的学习成就

            在文中由具体阅读与计算表现说明，不能直接等同于儿童智力较低。

            differs from the language used at home

            与家庭使用的语言不同

            differ from 比较两个明确对象，这里是学校教学语言和家庭语言。

            句子精读

            Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home.

            Tsimpli 和同事正在调查，这些较低的学习成果是否可能与印度学校的一种情况有关：儿童接受教学的语言常常不同于家里使用的语言。

            whether 从句是 investigating 的内容，could be caused 保留待验证的可能性。where 描述学校体系中的情况；that children are taught in 修饰 language，句末的 in 与该语言搭配，表示以某种语言授课。

            They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.

            这些儿童的家庭十分贫困，以至于他们不得不住在贫民区；而且，由于迁移，他们使用的语言可能不同于当地的地区语言。

            They 回指从偏远农村迁往城市的许多儿童。so poor 后省略了 that，引出居住条件的结果。and 后另加迁移造成的语言差异，may 保留个体差别；贫困与语言差异不是完全相同的一个原因。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            differs from the language used at home

            与家庭语言不同

            适合解释某些儿童理解课堂内容时面临的额外要求，避免把语言差异等同于能力不足。

            用于写作：小学正式学习与游戏题关注课堂学习体验；可用来说明具体情境下游戏和实物活动怎样支持理解，不把游戏宣称为所有语言困难的解决方案。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            Multilingualism · 教学语言与出人意料的结果未作答观点判断 YNNG / 选择题 · 4 段 · 362 词 · 4 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 87 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第5–8段连续裁切；题面sixth/eighth paragraph分别对应本片段第2/4段。保留may、might、preliminary等不确定表达。

            原文片段 · 1Having already tested 1,000 children, the researchers will now embark on retesting them. They intend to look not only at test results, but also at variables such as the standard of schooling, the environment and the teaching practices themselves. It's possible that one of the causes of low performance is the lack of pupil-centred teaching methods; in many Indian primary schools the teacher dominates and there is little room for independent learning.

            原文片段 · 2Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life. According to Tsimpli, most of the evidence from this and other projects shows that English instruction for children from low socio-economic areas might not be the best way for them to learn, at least in the first three years of primary education.

            原文片段 · 3'What we would recommend for everyone, not just low socio-economic status children, would be to start learning in the language they feel comfortable learning in ... English can still be used, but perhaps not as the medium of instruction in primary schools. It could, for example, be one of the subjects that are being taught alongside other subjects. We are not suggesting that English be withdrawn - that ship has sailed - but we perhaps have to think more about learner needs. There is perhaps too much uniformity in teaching and less tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs,' says Tsimpli.

            原文片段 · 4While the preliminary results show there is no difference in general intelligence among boys and girls from slum areas versus those from urban poor backgrounds, an unanticipated finding has been that children from slum backgrounds do not seem to lag behind children from other urban poor backgrounds - and in some cases outperform them (e.g. in numeracy and literacy tasks). According to the researchers, this unexpected finding may be down to the life experiences of children growing up in slums. They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.

            23. The researchers have decided against investigating the impact teaching methodology may have on learning outcomes.

            Do the following statements agree with the views/claims of the writer? Write YES, NO or NOT GIVEN.

            24. What point does the writer make about primary schools in India in the sixth paragraph?

            Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

            • A. Exposure to English outside of school is of limited benefit.
            • B. Children learn English more easily when they are well motivated.
            • C. Poor children may be disadvantaged further by being instructed in English.
            • D. There is little consistency across schools with regard to instruction in English.

            25. What is Tsimpli suggesting when she uses the phrase 'that ship has sailed'?

            Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

            • A. The findings of the report may be of little help to some Indian schoolchildren.
            • B. Instruction in English could be better adapted to the needs of schoolchildren.
            • C. Schools have had limited success in teaching English as a separate subject.
            • D. It is too late to remove English completely as a language of instruction in schools.

            26. In the eighth paragraph, what do we learn has surprised researchers?

            Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

            • A. Boys and girls from low socio-economic groups have similar general intelligence levels.
            • B. The age at which children move into a slum does not affect their academic performance.
            • C. Slum children and children from other urban poor backgrounds have similar life experiences.
            • D. The literacy and numeracy skills of slum children are not lower than those of children from other urban poor backgrounds.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 23 题 · NO

            intend to investigate practices直接反驳decided against investigating methodology。

            They intend to look not only at test results, but also ... the teaching practices themselves

            第 24 题 · C

            不熟悉教学用英语可能进一步拖住贫困儿童；不是说动机能使英语更容易学。

            English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language

            第 25 题 · D

            紧贴前半句be withdrawn理解：完全撤回英语已不现实。B是后文改进方向，却不是该习语所指。

            We are not suggesting that English be withdrawn - that ship has sailed

            第 26 题 · D

            unanticipated锁定意外发现：贫民窟儿童读写算并未落后，有时更好；general intelligence相同只是前面的背景。

            an unanticipated finding ... children from slum backgrounds do not seem to lag behind ... and in some cases outperform them

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            研究开始把授课语言、教学方式与儿童生活经验一起考虑。作者呈现的是初步结果：陌生的授课语言可能阻碍早期学习，贴合儿童需求比统一要求更合适；贫困住区儿童某些表现较好也不能反过来证明贫困本身有益。

            原文片段 · 1

            Having already tested 1,000 children, the researchers will now embark on retesting them. They intend to look not only at test results, but also at variables such as the standard of schooling, the environment and the teaching practices themselves. It's possible that one of the causes of low performance is the lack of pupil-centred teaching methods; in many Indian primary schools the teacher dominates and there is little room for independent learning.

            再次测试让研究者能继续观察儿童，而不只停留在一次结果。他们也看学校质量、环境和课堂做法；教师主导、缺少自主学习空间只是一个可能原因。It's possible 和 one of the causes 同时限制了因果判断。

            原文片段 · 2

            Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life. According to Tsimpli, most of the evidence from this and other projects shows that English instruction for children from low socio-economic areas might not be the best way for them to learn, at least in the first three years of primary education.

            研究初步发现，入学前及校外很少接触某种授课语言的儿童，可能受到语言本身的阻碍。关于英语不一定最适合的判断，特别限定在经济社会条件较弱儿童的小学前三年，不能读成所有年龄都不该学英语。

            原文片段 · 3

            'What we would recommend for everyone, not just low socio-economic status children, would be to start learning in the language they feel comfortable learning in ... English can still be used, but perhaps not as the medium of instruction in primary schools. It could, for example, be one of the subjects that are being taught alongside other subjects. We are not suggesting that English be withdrawn - that ship has sailed - but we perhaps have to think more about learner needs. There is perhaps too much uniformity in teaching and less tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs,' says Tsimpli.

            建议是先用儿童能自在理解的语言学习；英语仍可作为一门学科，而不必承担教授所有学科的媒介。that ship has sailed 表示完全撤回英语已不是现实方向。作者批评的是教学过于统一、对能力和需求调整不足，重点在怎样教而非排斥某种语言。

            原文片段 · 4

            While the preliminary results show there is no difference in general intelligence among boys and girls from slum areas versus those from urban poor backgrounds, an unanticipated finding has been that children from slum backgrounds do not seem to lag behind children from other urban poor backgrounds - and in some cases outperform them (e.g. in numeracy and literacy tasks). According to the researchers, this unexpected finding may be down to the life experiences of children growing up in slums. They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.

            初步结果中，贫民区儿童在一般智力上并不落后，某些识字与算数活动还表现更好。研究者推测日常生存经验让他们较早接触实用计算，但 may be down to 保留了原因的不确定性。比较对象是其他城市贫困背景儿童，不能直接推成贫困儿童总体优于富裕儿童。

            词语与搭配

            little room for independent learning

            自主学习的空间很少

            room 比喻机会和自由度，不是教室面积；与教师占主导的课堂情境相连。

            the medium of instruction

            教学使用的语言媒介

            区分用英语教其他学科与把英语本身作为一门课程，这两者的理解负担不同。

            tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs

            根据儿童语言能力与需求作调整

            tailoring 比喻量体裁衣，强调教学匹配具体学习者，而不是统一提高或降低难度。

            essential for day-to-day survival

            日常生存所必需的

            essential for 后接用途或需要；这里修饰孩子在日常生活中接触的数算技能。

            句子精读

            Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life.

            虽然研究仍处于初步阶段，Tsimpli 及其团队发现，学校使用的授课语言，尤其英语，可能妨碍那些入学前及校外对该语言不熟悉、接触也较少的儿童的学习进展。

            Although 先限定发现的成熟程度，may 再限定影响的确定性。who 从句说明是哪一类儿童；familiarity with 与 exposure to 分别表示熟悉和接触，二者共同指向 the language。不能删掉人群与场景限制。

            They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.

            他们可能更早成熟，也更密切地接触日常生存所必需的数算技能。

            They 指在贫民区长大的儿童。are likely to 同时作用于 mature 和 come 两个并列动作，表示研究者的可能解释。essential for day-to-day survival 后置修饰 skills，说明这些技能与生活需要的关系。

            这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

            little room for independent learning

            自主学习机会不足

            用来描述过度由教师控制的课堂，需要说明儿童缺少哪些探索或表达机会。

            用于写作：与小学正式教学和课堂游戏的平衡直接吻合，可具体表达过度正式教学的局限。

            essential for day-to-day survival

            日常生活维持所必需的

            只在确实涉及生活压力时使用；可以讨论压力带来的某些实际经验，但不要据此美化贫困。

            用于写作：家庭财富题比较成长资源与成年准备；原文提供了生活经验可能培养某些能力的思路，同时例句避免把局部观察扩大为贫困更好的结论。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            The Globemakers · 从生日礼物到制作难题未作答摘要填空 / 观点判断 YNNG · 4 段 · 368 词 · 10 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 90 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            开篇原第1–4段连续裁切，保留A–J完整词表。NG34/35已核对整篇，原文并未给柏拉图所受批评或最早地球仪的准确性评价。

            原文片段 · 1In 2008, Peter Bellerby, who lived in London, wanted to give his father a model globe for his eightieth birthday. What seemed simple enough to start with triggered an almost obsessive, decade-long journey, marked by a series of obstacles that would have deterred anyone less determined. It ended with his establishing the world's only bespoke globemaking company.

            原文片段 · 2The first surprise in The Globemakers, Bellerby's account of this impulsive enterprise, is that obtaining such a globe was not simply a matter of a quick online order and a repressed sigh at the shipping costs. After all, contrary to stubbornly held popular views of our ancestors' geographical ignorance, we have known that the world is spherical since at least the 6th century BCE. The ancient Greek philosopher Plato in his work Phaedo likened it to a leather ball, while the accolade of producing the first recorded globe goes to the ancient Greek philosopher Crates of Mallus, who is said to have made one in around 150 BCE. Surely, Bellerby reasoned, a good-quality globe wouldn't be difficult to find.

            原文片段 · 3Nearly two millennia later, however, it seemed that the art of globemaking had been largely forgotten. Bellerby came across shoddy commercial versions designed for school classrooms and genuine antiques in auction houses that would have bust his budget. Even his trips to Morocco and India, where surely the knowledge of artisan cartographers* had been preserved, drew a blank.

            原文片段 · 4Not one to be easily thwarted, Bellerby decided to make his own good-quality globe. In the process, almost everything that could possibly go wrong did so. Even the shape of the Earth posed a problem, as it is not quite a perfect sphere, but oblate (slightly flattened at the poles). Having decided to compromise and opt for two half-spherical pieces that could be fitted together, he was unable to discover anyone capable of casting moulds with sufficient accuracy to ensure that he would not be left with two half-spheres that were not quite the same circumference. Even after he eventually resolved this issue, extracting these from the moulds resulted in piles of cracked plaster of Paris** and clouds of choking dust in the workshop he had set up at the rear of his house.

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            一次寻找生日礼物的行动变成漫长的制球事业。作者用地球仪的悠久历史衬托现实中高质量成品和工艺人才的难寻，再具体展示模具精度及脱模问题，让制作困难有可理解的物质细节。

            原文片段 · 1

            In 2008, Peter Bellerby, who lived in London, wanted to give his father a model globe for his eightieth birthday. What seemed simple enough to start with triggered an almost obsessive, decade-long journey, marked by a series of obstacles that would have deterred anyone less determined. It ended with his establishing the world's only bespoke globemaking company.

            2008年的最初目标只是给父亲八十岁生日买一个地球仪，后来却延伸成十年左右的执着探索和定制企业。what seemed simple 与 a series of obstacles 对照，把简单购买到复杂事业的反差放在开头；关于企业独特性的说法属于原文叙述。

            原文片段 · 2

            The first surprise in The Globemakers, Bellerby's account of this impulsive enterprise, is that obtaining such a globe was not simply a matter of a quick online order and a repressed sigh at the shipping costs. After all, contrary to stubbornly held popular views of our ancestors' geographical ignorance, we have known that the world is spherical since at least the 6th century BCE. The ancient Greek philosopher Plato in his work Phaedo likened it to a leather ball, while the accolade of producing the first recorded globe goes to the ancient Greek philosopher Crates of Mallus, who is said to have made one in around 150 BCE. Surely, Bellerby reasoned, a good-quality globe wouldn't be difficult to find.

            作者插入古代已知地球呈球形及早期地球仪的历史，是为了说明 Bellerby 为什么以为好地球仪应该不难找。who is said to have made 保留对历史记载的转述性质。Surely 呈现人物当时的想当然，后文将让这一期待落空。

            原文片段 · 3

            Nearly two millennia later, however, it seemed that the art of globemaking had been largely forgotten. Bellerby came across shoddy commercial versions designed for school classrooms and genuine antiques in auction houses that would have bust his budget. Even his trips to Morocco and India, where surely the knowledge of artisan cartographers* had been preserved, drew a blank.

            现成市场两端都不能满足需求：学校用商品粗糙，古董又超出预算。远赴摩洛哥和印度仍未找到所需帮助。drew a blank 表示一无所获；这里的 artisan cartographers 指具有地图制作手艺的人，不只是现代数字地图从业者。

            原文片段 · 4

            Not one to be easily thwarted, Bellerby decided to make his own good-quality globe. In the process, almost everything that could possibly go wrong did so. Even the shape of the Earth posed a problem, as it is not quite a perfect sphere, but oblate (slightly flattened at the poles). Having decided to compromise and opt for two half-spherical pieces that could be fitted together, he was unable to discover anyone capable of casting moulds with sufficient accuracy to ensure that he would not be left with two half-spheres that were not quite the same circumference. Even after he eventually resolved this issue, extracting these from the moulds resulted in piles of cracked plaster of Paris** and clouds of choking dust in the workshop he had set up at the rear of his house.

            自己制作后，困难从地球并非完美球体开始，一直延伸到两半球周长一致和完整脱模。他选择近似球形是一种折中，但即使解决模具精度，石膏仍会破裂并产生粉尘。段落强调设计决定、制作精度与材料操作是不同层面的难题。

            词语与搭配

            marked by a series of obstacles

            伴随一连串障碍

            marked by 概括过程的显著特征；需要后文具体事件支撑，不能只用来空泛说事情困难。

            contrary to stubbornly held popular views

            与人们固执持有的流行看法相反

            contrary to 引出认识反差；stubbornly held 带有评论者对观念不易改变的评价。

            drew a blank

            没有找到所需结果

            固定表达，描述寻找过程无果，语气较生动；不是画出空白图形。

            with sufficient accuracy

            具有足够精度

            原文指模具精度必须达到两半球周长相合的要求，sufficient 与具体用途有关。

            句子精读

            What seemed simple enough to start with triggered an almost obsessive, decade-long journey, marked by a series of obstacles that would have deterred anyone less determined.

            起初看似再简单不过的一件事，却开启了一段近乎执着、长达十年的探索，其间一连串的障碍足以让决心稍弱的人退缩。

            What 从句整体作主语，指寻找地球仪这件事。marked by 补充 journey 的特征；that would have deterred 修饰 obstacles，用假设语气反衬 Bellerby 的坚持，不是叙述另一个真实退缩者。

            Even after he eventually resolved this issue, extracting these from the moulds resulted in piles of cracked plaster of Paris** and clouds of choking dust in the workshop he had set up at the rear of his house.

            即使他终于解决了这个问题，把半球从模具中取出来时，仍在房屋后方自己搭建的工作间里留下成堆开裂的熟石膏和令人呛咳的粉尘。

            this issue 回指两半球尺寸精度不一致，these 指半球件。extracting these from the moulds 是动名词短语作主语。Even after 表明先前难题解决并不代表整个过程顺利；he had set up 修饰 workshop。星号沿用材料中的注释标记。

            读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

            The Globemakers · 制作细节、历史匠人与书评判断未作答选择题 · 4 段 · 542 词 · 4 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 91 页

            按原题号作答。保留考试原文与题目难度；以下是连续原段裁切，未改写原文。

            原第5–8段连续裁切，共543词。为保留从工艺意外到最终书评的完整论证，未在段中截断；仍仅为原篇后半。题面seventh paragraph对应本片段第3段。

            原文片段 · 1This series of abortive experiments taught Bellerby a lot about the challenges of making globes, which he communicates here to the reader. Finding just the right way to prise the globes from the mould - a high-end air compressor finally did the trick - and locating the right paper and inks with which to make the gores (the sections of flat sheet mapping that are pasted onto the spherical globe) without the ink seeping out to create a mushy, unreadable mess took months and an alarming chunk out of his bank balance. Bellerby's frustration at the painstaking process of attaching the gores to the globe surface - after having found a glue with precisely the right adhesive qualities - is palpable. Right at the end of the process, he learnt that the paper had stretched slightly and so the final one overlapped the first by a centimetre (which may not seem a great deal, but when that represents 2 per cent of the Earth's diameter, it's equivalent to obliterating the Himalayas or wiping out Chile).

            原文片段 · 2Bellerby's account of the technical challenges of globe production is interspersed with a series of interludes on great globemakers of the past and cartographic history in general. Purists might wish for more map-making details, but Bellerby clearly found a kindred spirit in Martin Behaim. He was the Nuremberg entrepreneur who in 1492 created the Erdapfel, the world's oldest surviving globe, beautifully finished by a workshop of painters and other craftsmen, only to find that the explorer Christopher Columbus had stumbled upon the Americas the very same year, rendering his masterpiece instantly out of date. Something of Bellerby's unflinching ambition is reflected in the even more heroic efforts of the Italian cartographer Vincenzo Coronelli, who, in the seventeenth century, created two globes for Louis XIV of France. It took him twenty years to complete the monstrous pair, whose vast bulk - each with a diameter of around four metres - can still be admired in the National Library of France in Paris.

            原文片段 · 3Although a celebration of the revival of an ancient craft, Bellerby's book is also a lament for the fading away of centuries-old traditions. When he embarked on his globemaking odyssey, he struggled to find artisans with the skills to make the right moulds for the globes or foundries that could shape the meridians (the metal frames which girdle globes) in just the right way. Although he finally located the right craftsmen, some simply dropping in, serendipitously, to his workshop (by now in more suitable premises than his back room), many of these have now retired or passed away.

            原文片段 · 4Bellerby's father finally did receive his eightieth birthday present, albeit two years late. Bellerby went on to found a company which now turns out over six hundred globes a year for customers who can have their own tiny village marked or more unusual requests fulfilled. His book, beautifully illustrated with photographs of the various stages of his venture and a few illustrations of historic globes and maps, is hardly a blueprint for commercial success. But it is more than enough to stir up admiration for the craftsmanship of the great mapmakers of the past and the obsessive determination of a modern successor who revived their almost moribund art.

            第 37 题 · B

            直到最后才发现纸张拉伸产生重叠，是unexpected issue；原文未说他为此差点放弃。

            kindred spirit和ambition reflected都强调共同点，不证明他受二人启发才开始。

            第 40 题 · A

            hardly是否定；blueprint指可照着做的指南。因此书不教如何创造盈利生意，下一句赞赏不取消这一判断。

            His book ... is hardly a blueprint for commercial success

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            这篇书评把制作的微小误差、历史制球者的雄心与手艺传承的脆弱并置。最后肯定书中呈现的工艺和坚持，却明确不把这段经历当作可以照搬的商业成功指南。

            原文片段 · 1

            This series of abortive experiments taught Bellerby a lot about the challenges of making globes, which he communicates here to the reader. Finding just the right way to prise the globes from the mould - a high-end air compressor finally did the trick - and locating the right paper and inks with which to make the gores (the sections of flat sheet mapping that are pasted onto the spherical globe) without the ink seeping out to create a mushy, unreadable mess took months and an alarming chunk out of his bank balance. Bellerby's frustration at the painstaking process of attaching the gores to the globe surface - after having found a glue with precisely the right adhesive qualities - is palpable. Right at the end of the process, he learnt that the paper had stretched slightly and so the final one overlapped the first by a centimetre (which may not seem a great deal, but when that represents 2 per cent of the Earth's diameter, it's equivalent to obliterating the Himalayas or wiping out Chile).

            脱模、纸张、油墨与胶水分别需要反复试验，时间与资金不断消耗。gores 是贴到球面上的分瓣地图纸；纸张略微伸长使最后一片与第一片重叠。用喜马拉雅山和智利作比较，是将球面上一厘米的误差换成地理尺度，让小误差的严重性可感。

            原文片段 · 2

            Bellerby's account of the technical challenges of globe production is interspersed with a series of interludes on great globemakers of the past and cartographic history in general. Purists might wish for more map-making details, but Bellerby clearly found a kindred spirit in Martin Behaim. He was the Nuremberg entrepreneur who in 1492 created the Erdapfel, the world's oldest surviving globe, beautifully finished by a workshop of painters and other craftsmen, only to find that the explorer Christopher Columbus had stumbled upon the Americas the very same year, rendering his masterpiece instantly out of date. Something of Bellerby's unflinching ambition is reflected in the even more heroic efforts of the Italian cartographer Vincenzo Coronelli, who, in the seventeenth century, created two globes for Louis XIV of France. It took him twenty years to complete the monstrous pair, whose vast bulk - each with a diameter of around four metres - can still be admired in the National Library of France in Paris.

            技术经历之间穿插制图史人物：Behaim 的作品刚完成便因新的地理发现过时，Coronelli 又花二十年制作巨型地球仪。kindred spirit 指 Bellerby 在前辈身上看到相近的气质，不是亲属关系。这些插叙把个人执着放进更长的工艺历史中。

            原文片段 · 3

            Although a celebration of the revival of an ancient craft, Bellerby's book is also a lament for the fading away of centuries-old traditions. When he embarked on his globemaking odyssey, he struggled to find artisans with the skills to make the right moulds for the globes or foundries that could shape the meridians (the metal frames which girdle globes) in just the right way. Although he finally located the right craftsmen, some simply dropping in, serendipitously, to his workshop (by now in more suitable premises than his back room), many of these have now retired or passed away.

            书既庆祝古老手艺复兴，也为传统消失而惋惜。寻找模具与金属子午圈工匠十分困难，即使偶然遇到合适的人，其中不少后来已退休或去世。两次 Although 强调成功与损失并存；制作知识需要活着的从业者才能继续传递。

            原文片段 · 4

            Bellerby's father finally did receive his eightieth birthday present, albeit two years late. Bellerby went on to found a company which now turns out over six hundred globes a year for customers who can have their own tiny village marked or more unusual requests fulfilled. His book, beautifully illustrated with photographs of the various stages of his venture and a few illustrations of historic globes and maps, is hardly a blueprint for commercial success. But it is more than enough to stir up admiration for the craftsmanship of the great mapmakers of the past and the obsessive determination of a modern successor who revived their almost moribund art.

            生日礼物迟到两年后终于送达，公司随后发展出大量定制需求。但书评者认为，插图精美和故事成功不等于它是商业操作蓝图；真正值得读的是对历史工艺的敬佩，以及让濒于消失的技艺再生的坚持。hardly 和 But 标出这一有保留的赞赏。

            词语与搭配

            the painstaking process

            需要细致耐心的过程

            painstaking 强调投入细心与努力，并不等于过程带来身体疼痛。

            is interspersed with

            其间穿插着

            用于描述书、文章等内容编排：主要叙述之间穿插另一类材料。

            a kindred spirit

            志趣或气质相投的人

            原文把现代制球者与历史人物联系起来，表达精神上的相近。

            the revival of an ancient craft

            古老手艺的复兴

            revival 意味着某项活动曾衰落，如今重新活跃；不能用于一直稳定存在的所有传统。

            句子精读

            Bellerby 的书虽然是在庆祝一门古老手艺的复兴，也是在哀叹延续数百年的传统正在消失。

            Although 后省略了 it is，celebration 与 lament 构成情感上的对照。the fading away of 把逐渐消失的过程名词化。also 表示两种态度同时存在，作者不是在下一句撤回对复兴的肯定。

            But it is more than enough to stir up admiration for the craftsmanship of the great mapmakers of the past and the obsessive determination of a modern successor who revived their almost moribund art.

            但它足以激起人们对昔日伟大制图者工艺的敬佩，也让人敬佩这位现代继承者近乎执着的决心：他使他们那几乎已经衰亡的技艺重新焕发生机。

            鸟类起源：理论提出、反驳与新证据未作答句子填空 · 3 段 · 341 词 · 2 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

            Academic官方机考样题 · IELTS Academic Reading official computer sample · The origins of birds

            完成下列原句，填入原文对应词语。本组保留官方原题号；实际官方答案每空均为一个词。

            同一篇官方原文的连续三段裁切，不计作另一篇材料。统一字数上限未载于本地QTI，未补造正式上限。

            2The 'birds are dinosaurs' theory was first developed by English palaeontologist Thomas Huxley (1825–1895). According to some accounts, one evening Huxley went to dinner still thinking about a mystery dinosaur bone in his lab. He knew he was dealing with the lower leg bone (tibia) of a meat-eating, two-legged dinosaur belonging to the classification known as theropods, but attached to the tibia was an unidentified extra bone. On the menu that evening was quail, a small bird similar to a pheasant, and Huxley noticed the same strange bone, attached to the quail tibia on his plate. He later realised that it was in fact the bird's anklebone. More importantly, Huxley concluded that its forms in both dinosaur and bird skeletons were so similar that they must be closely related.

            3Huxley's idea fell out of favour for fifty years following the 1916 publication of The Origin of Birds by the Danish doctor Gerhard Heilmann. During this time, Heilmann’s theory was widely accepted. Heilmann had noted that two-legged, meat-eating dinosaurs lacked collarbones. In later evolutionary stages these bones fuse together to form the distinctive 'Y'-shaped bone in a bird's neck, known as the furcula. Heilmann proposed the notion that such a feature could not be lost and then re-evolve at a later date, so dinosaurs could not be the ancestors of birds.

            4Then, in the late 1960s, John Ostrom from Yale University in the USA, noted 22 features in the skeletons of meat-eating dinosaurs that were also found in birds and nowhere else. This reset the thinking on bird ancestry and once again Huxley’s ideas caught the attention of the scientific community. Subsequent work has found up to 85 characteristics that tie dinosaurs and birds together. But what of Heilmann's missing bones? It turns out that not only did many dinosaurs have collarbones, these were also fused together into a furcula. Unfortunately for Heilmann, the fossil evidence was somewhat lacking in his day, and the few furculae that had been found were misidentified, usually as belly ribs.

            1. Huxley formulated his theory while studying a dinosaur belonging to a group called ________ .

            2. Heilmann rejected Huxley’s theory because of the apparent absence of ________ in dinosaurs.

            对照答案，回到证据

            第 1 题 · theropods

            group called问分类，theropods是类别；tibia是腿骨，quail是鸟，都不是恐龙类别。

            a meat-eating, two-legged dinosaur belonging to the classification known as theropods

            第 2 题 · collarbones

            apparent absence对应lacked。后文说明后来发现许多恐龙有锁骨，不能用后来的知识改写Heilmann当时的反对理由。

            Heilmann had noted that two-legged, meat-eating dinosaurs lacked collarbones.

            核对原答案页

            材料精读 · 内容与词句

            三段按提出关联、否定关联、重新评价的顺序讲述鸟类与恐龙关系研究的变化。变化的关键是骨骼证据的解释，而不是简单的“旧学者对、新学者错”。阅读时要把当时的判断与后来材料所述发现区分开。

            2

            The 'birds are dinosaurs' theory was first developed by English palaeontologist Thomas Huxley (1825–1895). According to some accounts, one evening Huxley went to dinner still thinking about a mystery dinosaur bone in his lab. He knew he was dealing with the lower leg bone (tibia) of a meat-eating, two-legged dinosaur belonging to the classification known as theropods, but attached to the tibia was an unidentified extra bone. On the menu that evening was quail, a small bird similar to a pheasant, and Huxley noticed the same strange bone, attached to the quail tibia on his plate. He later realised that it was in fact the bird's anklebone. More importantly, Huxley concluded that its forms in both dinosaur and bird skeletons were so similar that they must be closely related.

            第2段叙述赫胥黎从恐龙腿骨与鹌鹑骨骼的相似处受到启发，并把额外骨骼认作踝骨。According to some accounts把晚餐故事标为一些记载中的说法。他据两类骨骼形态相近推断关系密切，段落重点是比较解剖结构怎样促成一个解释。

            3

            Huxley's idea fell out of favour for fifty years following the 1916 publication of The Origin of Birds by the Danish doctor Gerhard Heilmann. During this time, Heilmann’s theory was widely accepted. Heilmann had noted that two-legged, meat-eating dinosaurs lacked collarbones. In later evolutionary stages these bones fuse together to form the distinctive 'Y'-shaped bone in a bird's neck, known as the furcula. Heilmann proposed the notion that such a feature could not be lost and then re-evolve at a later date, so dinosaurs could not be the ancestors of birds.

            第3段交代赫胥黎的观点为何一度失去支持：海尔曼认为某类恐龙没有锁骨，又认为这种特征不可能消失后再次演化出现，于是排除了它们作为鸟类祖先的可能。这里是在解释他的论证前提，不是在把“恐龙没有锁骨”继续当作事实。

            4

            Then, in the late 1960s, John Ostrom from Yale University in the USA, noted 22 features in the skeletons of meat-eating dinosaurs that were also found in birds and nowhere else. This reset the thinking on bird ancestry and once again Huxley’s ideas caught the attention of the scientific community. Subsequent work has found up to 85 characteristics that tie dinosaurs and birds together. But what of Heilmann's missing bones? It turns out that not only did many dinosaurs have collarbones, these were also fused together into a furcula. Unfortunately for Heilmann, the fossil evidence was somewhat lacking in his day, and the few furculae that had been found were misidentified, usually as belly ribs.

            第4段呈现后来对共同特征的重新识别，以及更多相关骨骼证据。缺失锁骨的问题被重新解释为当时化石不足、已发现标本遭到误认。up to 85表示后续工作记录的数量上限式表述，不是说每种恐龙与每种鸟都有完全相同的85项特征。

            词语与搭配

            fell out of favour

            失去支持；不再受到认可

            描述某种观点在群体中的接受程度发生变化，不等于该观点已被最终证明错误。

            widely accepted

            被广泛接受

            widely指接受范围广；广泛认可与证据充分、结论永远不变不是同一概念。

            caught the attention of the scientific community

            引起科学界注意

            catch the attention of强调获得注意，尚不等于所有研究者完全赞成。

            the fossil evidence was somewhat lacking

            化石证据当时有些不足

            somewhat表示程度上的保留；lacking指不足，不能扩大成完全没有任何化石。

            句子精读

            He knew he was dealing with the lower leg bone (tibia) of a meat-eating, two-legged dinosaur belonging to the classification known as theropods, but attached to the tibia was an unidentified extra bone.

            他知道自己研究的是属于兽脚类的一种食肉、两足恐龙的胫骨，但胫骨上还连着一块身份不明的额外骨骼。

            He指赫胥黎；meat-eating和two-legged共同修饰dinosaur，belonging to...进一步交代分类。but之后使用倒装attached to the tibia was...，把附着位置置前，再引出那块骨骼。

            Unfortunately for Heilmann, the fossil evidence was somewhat lacking in his day, and the few furculae that had been found were misidentified, usually as belly ribs.

            对海尔曼而言遗憾的是，他所处时代的化石证据有所不足，而且当时已经找到的少数叉骨也被误认，通常被当作腹肋。

            his day指海尔曼研究所处的时代；the few furculae中的that had been found限定此前发现的标本。had been found先于were misidentified所述误认过程的叙述位置，两个被动结构把注意力放在证据遭遇上。
